### Metal Roof Cost

How Much Does a Metal Roof CostAverage Cost:$10,000 and $50,000As of 2025, the cost of installing a metal roof typically falls between $5 and $25 per square foot, depending on the material and style you choose. More affordable options, like corrugated metal, start at around $5 per square foot, while premium selections—such as standing seam metal—can range from $10 to $25 per square foot.While metal roofing comes at a higher upfront cost compared to traditional asphalt shingles, it’s often a worthwhile investment, particularly in regions where durability against extreme weather is a top priority.																										




SCHEDULE A FREE ESTIMATE


 727-677-4824 | QUICK PITCH | SERVICES |  ROOFING CALCULATOR




Investing in a metal roof is a decision that offers long-term benefits, particularly in Florida’s demanding climate. While the initial cost is higher than traditional shingles, the durability, energy efficiency, and weather resistance of metal roofing make it a smart investment. In the Greater Tampa Bay Area, metal roof cost typically falls between $5 and $25 per square foot, meaning homeowners with a 2,000-square-foot roof can expect to pay between $10,000 and $50,000, depending on materials and installation style.One of the biggest cost factors is the type of metal roofing system you choose. Exposed fastener options, like corrugated metal panels, are more budget-friendly, ranging from $5 to $12 per square foot. On the higher end, standing seam metal roofs—which conceal fasteners for a sleeker, more durable finish—typically range from $10 to $25 per square foot. Material selection also plays a major role, with Galvalume steel offering a balance of affordability and performance, while premium options like copper come at a higher price point.For Florida homeowners, where hurricanes and extreme weather are a concern, metal roofing provides unmatched resilience and peace of mind. If you're considering a metal roof, understanding these cost factors will help you make an informed decision that suits both your home and budget.																										Price Ranges For Different Metal TypesGalvanized Steel with Visible Fasteners ($5 - $12 per square foot): $10,000 - $24,000Galvalume Steel with Visible Fasteners ($6 - $13 per square foot): $12,000 - $26,000Aluminum with Visible Fasteners ($7 - $15 per square foot): $14,000 - $30,000Standing Seam with Hidden Fasteners ($10 - $25 per square foot): $20,000 - $50,000These price ranges are estimates for a 2,000-square-foot house and can vary based on factors like installation complexity and material quality.At PITCH Roofing, we believe that investing in a metal roof should enhance both your property's protection and its curb appeal. While the initial metal roof cost might seem daunting, the long-term benefits, such as lower energy bills and reduced maintenance costs, make it a wise choice for many Florida homeowners. To get an accurate estimate tailored to your specific needs, consider scheduling a free roofing estimate with our expert team, who can guide you through your options and help you make the best decision for your home and budget.

Additional Costs For A Metal RoofWhen planning for a metal roof installation, it's important to consider additional costs that might arise beyond the basic roofing materials and labor. One potential expense is the need for structural reinforcements, especially if you're upgrading from a lighter roofing material like asphalt shingles to a heavier metal roof. Your existing roof deck and support structure might need to be strengthened to handle the weight, which could add to the overall cost.Another consideration is the removal and disposal of your old roof. If your existing roof needs to be torn off before the new metal roof is installed, this process can incur additional labor costs and disposal fees. Furthermore, if there are underlying issues such as rot or damage to the roof deck, repairs will be necessary before the new roof can be installed, further increasing the total project cost. These factors should be discussed during your initial estimate to ensure a clear understanding of all potential expenses.How Long Does It Take To Install A Metal Roof?Installing a metal roof on a 2,000-square-foot house typically takes about three to five days, depending on factors like weather conditions, the complexity of the roof design, and the type of metal roofing being used. The process includes removing the old roof (if necessary), making any required repairs to the roof deck, and then installing the new metal roof panels. Efficient and experienced roofing crews can complete the job within this timeframe, ensuring a high-quality installation that’s both timely and effective.

### New Port Richey

New Port Richey is known for its gorgeous views of the Gulf of Mexico. But a lesser-known reality of living in New Port Richey is all of the roofing problems.

Pasco County is rife with weather patterns that can damage your roof. Humidity, UV rays, heavy rains, and hurricane-force winds all take a serious toll on your roof. And if you’re going to keep your home or business safe and protected, then you need experienced professionals on your side.

That’s us. PITCH Roofing is a trusted local roofing partner with years of experience providing roofing services in and around New Port Richey. Now, let’s talk about how our friendly crew of roofing veterans can help with your Pasco County roofing needs!
New Port Richey Roof Replacements
Installing and replacing roofs is one of the most common roofing services that we provide in New Port Richey. Whether your roof has naturally reached the end of its life or it’s been damaged by a storm, we’ll be able to tear off your old roof and install a new one that looks great and keeps your property safe. As experienced New Port Richey roofers, we cover many types of roof replacements, including:

 	Shingle roofing
 	Tile roofing
 	Metal roofing
 	Flat roofing

With all of these different roof replacement options, we make sure our customers always get exactly what they’re looking for. And as Owens Corning Preferred Contractors, we provide our customers with great shingle products, the best warranties, and peace of mind at every stage of the roof replacement process.
Pasco County Roof Repairs
Wear and tear is a factor wherever you go. But in New Port Richey, the stakes are even higher. Let’s say that your roof is missing a few shingles, for example. Without prompt repairs, humidity or even a storm could cause water damage to your roof’s vulnerable decking and lead to larger, more widespread roofing problems. In the worst-case scenario, it could even change a simple roof repair to something requiring a full roof replacement.

It can be tempting to put off repairs until a “better time.” But the truth is that the best time to get your roofing problems addressed is yesterday, and the second best time is today. If you’re experiencing roofing troubles, it’s important to reach out to qualified roofers ASAP.

At Pitch, we pride ourselves on our great roof repair services in New Port Richey. We don’t do surface-level patch jobs that fix the issue today but leave a larger problem looming in your home. Instead, we fix the problem at the source so that you can have total peace of mind about your roof’s safety and protection. In other words, you can count on us to get your roof ready to last for many more years to come!

### Ruskin

When you need roofing services in Ruskin, Florida, PITCH Roofing is the natural choice. As licensed, experienced Tampa Bay roofers, we’ve seen it all. So whether you need a roof replacement, roof repairs, or routine maintenance, our friendly crew has the know-how and expertise to get the job done right.Ruskin’s Top Roofing CompanyOur founders made Pitch with one purpose: to right the wrongs that they saw in the Florida roofing industry. Many roofers in Florida are great, but as a state that’s heavily targeted by storm chasers, there are common issues that we see, including shoddy workmanship, poor communication, and disappointed customers.But that’s enough about our background. Now, let’s talk about something much more important: what Pitch can do for you.Affordable Roofing in RuskinWhen you need a new roof, it’s normal to be concerned about the price tag. But the solution isn’t to look for cheap roofing. Instead, you should look for high-quality roofing that comes at an affordable cost.That’s exactly what we provide. As masters of many types of roofing, including shingles, tiles, metal, and flat roofing, there’s no job that we can’t handle. And with detailed, comprehensive estimates, we offer 100% transparent pricing so that you can make an informed decision.The cherry on top is our 0% roof financing. If the roof of your dreams isn’t in your budget right now, that’s fine. We’ll make it easy to get the protection your home deserves while paying off your new roof on a more comfortable schedule. This way, there’s no compromise between budget and high-quality roofing!Expert Roof Repairs and MaintenanceWith the weather in Ruskin, it’s likely that you’ll need roofing services before it’s time to replace your roof. Between humidity, hurricane-force winds, and UV rays, your roof faces a lot of wear and tear every day. That’s why it’s important to keep up with roof repairs and maintenance.At Pitch, there’s no limit to what we can do for your roof. Some of our most common Ruskin roofing services include:Roof inspectionsLeak detection and repairReplacing missing shinglesFixing roof saggingRepairing and replacing soffits and fasciaFixing flashingRestoring guttersWith this kind of expertise, we can help you with virtually any roofing problem in Hillsborough County!

An online roofing cost calculator has a lot of pros. It’s convenient, it’s free, and it’s fast, to name some of its best features. But there are some tasks that it’s not suited for. So how do you know if our online roof replacement cost calculator can help?

We’re going to answer that exact question. Join us as we walk you through when you should use an online roofing calculator and when you may need a more personalized roofing estimate.
When to Use an Online Roofing Cost Calculator
An online roofing cost calculator works by using a roof idea of your roof and what it needs. For example, if you want to find out how much a metal roof replacement costs, you can put your address into an online cost calculator. This will then estimate the size of your roof and give you an estimate using its best guess of how much materials, labor, and permits will cost.

But at the end of the day, it’s just that: a guess. These systems often use national averages, which may or may not be accurate for your roof in Florida. For this reason, it’s always more accurate to get a detailed estimate from real roofers in your community, like Pitch.

Does this mean that there’s never a good time to use an online roofing cost calculator? Absolutely not! These are handy tools that can help you start the roofing process. Some of the times we recommend using an online roofing cost calculator include:

 	If you’re considering upgrading to a new roofing material
 	You haven’t had a roof replacement before and aren’t sure what to expect
 	Situations where you want to explore your roofing material options
 	You’re deciding whether or not you want to invest in a roof replacement right now

All of these situations are times when a roofing cost calculator can do you a lot of good. However, it’s important to know the limits of these tools and when you need the services of a real, local roofing pro.

When NOT to Use an Online Roofing Cost Calculator
Sometimes, you don’t need an online roofing cost calculator. Instead, what you need is a trained professional to personally inspect your roof and prepare a reliable estimate for what the job will cost. And at Pitch, we pride ourselves on our comprehensive estimates that cover the full scope of work, from the first day we’re on your roof to that final inspection with the county.

So when do you need a real professional in your corner? Signs that an online roofing cost calculator might not help you include:

 	Being ready to make a final decision on who does your roof and what kind of work you need
 	Wanting local, 100% reliable roofing costs
 	Needing a full outline of the scope of your roofing project
 	Requiring roofing estimates for your insurance

For all of these needs, choose to work with real people instead of an online roof replacement cost calculator. While these do take a bit more time to prepare, they’re worth it when you need a reliable, accurate number that reflects what you’ll actually pay for your roof.
Getting Your Free, No-obligation Roofing Estimate
If you’re ready to get a free, accurate roofing estimate, give us a call or sign up online. We’ll work with you to promptly get you scheduled for an in-person roof inspection and estimate that will clear up any doubts about your total roofing costs.

Or, if you’d rather keep things online, that’s okay too! We have a special online-only roofing estimate process where you can get an estimate without the in-person inspection. And the best part is that this is still a reliable number, not just a rough guess like what you’ll get from an online roof cost calculator!

### My Safe Florida Approved

MEETING STANDARDS		
		 My Safe Florida Home Approved 
				The My Safe Florida Home program is one of the best ways for homeowners to save money on their roof upgrades. This innovative program will cover roofing costs equal to $2 for every $1 you spend, up to $10,000. So if you get $10,000 in roof upgrades, you'll only pay $3,333!
		These funds can go to a wide variety of roof improvements, including:Installing a secondary water barrierReinforcing your roof decking attachmentsUpgrading your roof coveringsWith a deal this good, you're basically leaving money on the table if you don't sign up for the My Safe Florida Home program. So what's the catch?There's no downside to using this program, but there are some criteria that you have to meet. Applications will be processed starting July 1st, 2024, and priority will be given to homeowners who have low incomes and/or are seniors.And once you qualify, there's just one final step left: picking your roofing contractors.Because this program uses state tax dollars, there are high standards for what contractors you can use for these roof improvements. To qualify for the My Safe Florida Home list of approved contractors, roofers must prove that they're reliable, insured, and have the expertise to help Florida-proof your home.At PITCH Roofing, we've got all of these qualifications and more. And as My Safe Florida Home approved contractors, we are ready and willing to upgrade your roof while saving you money with this exciting program.In the past, funds for the My Safe Florida Home program have run out quickly! So if you're interested in upgrading your roof without burning through your savings, don't wait to apply.On July 1st, the My Safe Florida Home's portal will re-open and you'll be able to sign up for your free wind mitigation inspection. Once that's completed, they'll send you a list of approved contractors to complete your roofing work, and you can pick the professionals at PITCH Roofing to prepare your roof for the next major hurricane!

WHY PITCH		
		 Owens Corning Preferred Contractors 
				PITCH Roofing takes pride in being recognized as an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor. But we didn't do it for ourselves — we became OC Preferred Contractors for you. To earn this certification, you have to prove to be a reliable, experienced roofing company that looks out for its customers, and that's exactly the kind of peace of mind that we're committed to giving you.

As a Preferred Contractor, we are held to rigorous standards, including maintaining all necessary state and local licenses, carrying a minimum of $1,000,000 in general liability insurance, and undergoing regular screenings for financial stability and customer service. These criteria ensure that we are fully equipped to offer superior service and reliable outcomes to all our clients.

By choosing PITCH Roofing, you're entrusting your property to seasoned professionals. Our team receives ongoing training from Owens Corning, ensuring we are at the forefront of the latest industry techniques and products. Choose us for your roofing needs and experience the peace of mind that comes with working with a top-tier contractor!

### PITCH Roofing Warranty

PROTECTION		
		 Full Warranty Info 
				PITCH Roofing, utilizing Owens Corning® products, offers top-tier warranties in the roofing industry, ensuring your peace of mind. We simplify the process for you to understand, compare, and choose the perfect warranty for your roof. Managing your warranty is equally straightforward—whether you're registering, transferring, or filing a claim, every step is streamlined for quick, hassle-free completion. Trust PITCH Roofing and Owens Corning® for exceptional protection of your home.
																														
			PEACE OF MIND		
		 Protect your investment  
				Preferred provides full replacement coverage for manufacturing defects on your Owens Corning® shingles and all Owens Corning® roofing components for 50 years. This warranty includes a 10-year limited warranty on contractor workmanship.
		Peace of MindThe Preferred Protection Roofing System Limited Warranty* has up to a 50-year “non-prorated” period for both material defects and the labor to repair or replace them, whereas many standard warranties have a 10-year non-prorated warranty period. With the Preferred Protection Roofing System Limited Warranty,* you can rest easy knowing you have this coverage.In addition, you will receive 10 years of workmanship protection. Meaning, if your roof is found to have an application error, Owens Corning Roofing will arrange to have it repaired, with labor, materials, tear-off and disposal costs all covered.One-time TransferWhether you’re staying in your home for years to come or planning to sell, the Preferred Protection Roofing System Limited Warranty is transferable,* making it an excellent investment. If you’re planning to sell, this warranty may provide a highly desirable benefit to future homebuyers.CoverageThe Preferred Protection Roofing System Limited Warranty* provides coverage for both material defects and the labor to repair or replace them, including tear-off and disposal. and VentSure®Additionally, every Owens Corning® roofing component, except the electrical components of the VentSure® Solar Attic Exhaust Fan, off-ridge exhaust vents, take on the warranty of the shingle installed, in many cases, extending their warranty period. The Preferred Protection Roofing System Limited Warranty* does not cover non-Owens Corning® roofing components such as flashing, fasteners, pipe boots and wood decking.Compare our CoverageA new roof is an important investment in your home, and it’s critical that you understand the warranty protection that comes with it. 			WHO WE ARE		
		 FAST, FRIENDLY, RELIABLE ROOFING 
				At PITCH Roofing, we define ourselves not just as another roofing company, but as dedicated local partners in roofing excellence. Our founders established Pitch with a mission rooted in addressing the prevalent dishonesty and subpar service plaguing the Florida roofing industry. This vision was born from witnessing the deceptive practices of transient "roof chasers" and local roofers cutting corners with substandard subcontractors. With over 60 years of combined roofing experience, our founders crafted PITCH Roofing to provide trustworthy, exceptional service to our community.

We specialize in both minor repairs and comprehensive roof replacements, delivering solutions that are not only functional but also enhance your home's visual appeal and durability against harsh weather. Our approach goes beyond mere technical service; we emphasize a customer-first attitude, ensuring transparent, honest interactions from your initial estimate to the final inspection.

Situated in Tampa Bay, our local team of seasoned roofing professionals is always ready to assist. If you're considering roofing services and value local expertise and a commitment to quality, reach out to us. Let PITCH Roofing show you how seamless and effective roofing solutions can be when you have experienced professionals by your side.

### Veterans, Teachers and First Responders Roofing Discount

THANK YOU		
		 We Appreciate Veterans, Teachers, First Responders and Their Families 
				At PITCH Roofing, we proudly support our veterans and first responders by offering a special roofing discount as a token of gratitude for their service to our community and country. You’ve given to and sacrificed for your community, and now it’s our turn to give back. Our veteran and first responder roofing discount varies depending on the type of work needed, making it flexible to meet the diverse needs of our local heroes.

We recognize that the needs of every home are different, which is why our team at PITCH Roofing works closely with veterans and first responders to tailor our services to their specific requirements. Whether it's a new roof installation, repairs, or routine maintenance, our experts are here to provide top-notch service. By offering this discount, we want to take some of the financial pressure off your shoulders so you can enjoy the comfort and security of a well-maintained roof without any added stress.

To take advantage of our veteran and first responder roofing discount, we encourage eligible individuals to contact us directly for a detailed consultation. Our team will provide a transparent estimate, taking into account the unique aspects of your roofing needs and applying the discount where applicable. At PITCH Roofing, we are honored to serve those who have served us, ensuring that every project we undertake reflects our deep appreciation and respect for our veterans and first responders as well as their immediate family members.

### Your Guide to Flat Roof Replacements

Whether for a residential or commercial structure, flat roof replacements are a critical part of protecting your property. This is especially true in Florida, where rainstorms and hurricanes can pose a serious threat to old, damaged flat roofs. But do you know about all of the flat roofing options in Florida?We’re here to make sure that you do. PITCH Roofing was founded by experts with more than 60 years of experience in the roofing industry. Based right here in Pinellas County, nobody knows Florida roofing like we do. Let us prove it to you as we walk you through everything you need to know about Florida flat roof replacements!Flat Roof Replacement MaterialsIn some ways, all flat roof materials work in the same way. Whereas sloped roofing materials (like shingles or tiles) only have to minimally protect against water since it moves freely off of sloped roofs, flat roofs have to have superior water protection to compensate for slower drainage.This is also why you have to be careful with who you choose to do your flat roof replacement. A properly installed flat roof isn’t completely flat; it just has a very low slope. If your installers don’t carefully ensure that your roof is angled to help move water off, your flat roof could develop issues with water pooling. This can lead to issues with leaks, weathering, and pests.But while all flat roofs serve the same goal, they come in many different materials. To get you ready for your flat roof replacement, let’s talk about some of the different ways that Pitch can get you a high-quality flat roof.Modified BitumenModified bitumen, or mod bit, is one of the most popular flat roofing options in Florida. This asphalt-based roofing material combines water-resistant rubber and fiberglass reinforcement to effectively protect your structure against the Florida elements. Thanks to its wide range of applications, mod bit is a common choice for both homes and commercial properties.Part of what makes it so versatile is its tensile strength. Unlike some other low-slope roofing materials, mod bit resists puncture damage from storm debris and foot traffic. This means you don’t have to worry about branches falling in a storm and creating weak points in your roof! Thanks to this quality protection, mod bit roofs average around 20 years of life.Modified bitumen flat roofs are generally black. This can help cover dirt and staining over the years, which is great if you own a commercial property where parts of the roof are visible from the interior of the building. On the other hand, this darker coloration also attracts more heat, so it can make your AC system work a bit harder in the summer months.TPOTPO, thermoplastic polyolefin, is a low-slope roofing membrane. In other words, it’s a single-ply roofing material that heat-adheres to your roof. This rubberized roof then creates a waterproof barrier to keep your roof decking dry and secure.Invented in the 90s, TPO roofs are estimated to live for 20-30 years Since this is a relatively new roofing material, though, experts aren’t 100% sure exactly how long the average TPO roof lasts. It’s safe to expect a long life though, since its rubberized composition allows it to easily expand and contract with the sun’s heat, which prevents premature weathering.Unlike mod bit, TPO is usually white. That means that your TPO roof will help reflect UV rays away from your structure and lower your energy bill. This can help offset flat roof installation costs and make TPO roofing more budget-friendly.		
			Call 727-677-4824		
		The Cost of a Flat Roof Replacement in FloridaNow that you know the different types of flat roof replacements, let’s talk about how much they cost. For almost every roof replacement, price is a significant factor. But it’s important to balance a roof’s value alongside its installation costs.With that in mind, let’s talk about how much each of these flat roofing materials could cost you in Florida!Mod Bit: This is a very budget-friendly roofing material. At four to eight dollars per square foot, flat roofs don’t get more affordable than mod bit. On a 2,000-square-foot roof, that puts the modified bitumen cost range between $8,000 and $16,000.TPO: This rubberized roofing material costs between four and 10 dollars per square foot, making it roughly equitable to modified bitumen. On that same 2,000-square-foot roof, your flat roof replacement costs would fall between $8,000 and $20,000.Ranges like this are helpful guidelines, but you’ll need more information to plan a low-slope roof replacement. To find out exactly how much your new low-slope roof will cost, you need to start collecting roofing estimates.Get Your Free Flat Roof Replacement EstimateFinding out exactly how much your flat roof replacement will cost is easy. 				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

### Metal Roof Replacement Guide for Floridians

Metal roofing is one of the best ways to Florida-proof your home or business. While nothing can guarantee protection against a Category 5 hurricane, steel roofs stand up well to all of Florida’s biggest roof killers, including wind, rain, and UV exposure. But do you know enough about this roofing material to commit to a metal roof replacement?Our local roofing experts are here to make sure you’re informed on everything you need to know. That means we’re answering all of your questions about metal roof replacements right here! We’re PITCH Roofing, and we want to start out by walking you through the basics of what property owners should know about metal roofing.What to Know About Getting a Metal Roof ReplacementAt the start of the metal roof replacement process, it’s normal to have a lot of questions. You may have some idea of metal roofing as being unsightly or especially loud during rainstorms, but recent advances in metal roofing technology have come a long way.For instance, many people worry about metal roofs rusting in humid Florida. While this can be a concern in some situations, most metal roofs now come equipped with ways to protect against rust, such as aluminum coatings. And thanks to improved insulation, metal roofs are now virtually no louder during a storm than any other roofing material.Another thing that many homeowners don’t realize is how important fasteners are for a metal roof replacement. Your fasteners determine how your roof adheres to the rest of your structure, and this can have a large impact on the lifespan of your roof and the level of maintenance that it needs.To help you plan for your metal roof replacement, let’s talk about your options when it comes to fasteners.Exposed FastenersExposed fasteners are used for a kind of metal roofing called corrugated or 5V metal roofing. In short, roofers drill these corrugated metal sheets into your structure. This means that visible fasteners will be visible across the length of your roof.In some ways, this is a good thing. After all, it’s hard for wind to remove a roof that’s securely drilled down. But since the fasteners are exposed, they can rust and weather with age. For this reason, exposed fastener metal roof replacements only last for 30-45 years on average. The silver lining, however, is that 5V metal roofs cost substantially less than metal roof replacements with hidden fasteners.In terms of aesthetics, exposed fastener metal roofs have a more industrial look. This doesn’t mean that you can’t get exposed fasteners for your residential structure. Rather, you should just be aware that your roof might have an unconventional aesthetic. But as we see more and more homes in Florida get exposed fastener metal roof replacements to protect against hurricanes, this sight could become common before long!Hidden FastenersHidden fasteners, or standing seam metal roofing, work quite differently from 5V. Their metal roofing sheets are mostly smooth and flat, for one thing, only elevating at the seam where the panels lock together. Since they fasten beneath the panel, the fastener is hidden and protected.This comes with substantial benefits. For one thing, the elements won’t wear down your fasteners as easily. That’s why standing seam metal roof replacements last for 50-70 years. Of course, the downside to this type of metal roof is that it comes with especially high roof replacement costs.But for many homeowners, this investment is worth it. The sleek, smooth finish of standing seam metal roofs creates a very modern look on a home. So if you want a metal roof replacement that will greatly increase your home’s curb appeal, hidden fasteners are a great choice.Metal Roofing Guide - Videohttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7p55f83KvPU

		How Much Does a Metal Roof Replacement Cost?We’ve hinted that hidden fasteners cost more than exposed fasteners, but how much does a metal roof replacement really cost?One thing to know is that metal roofing is never the cheapest option. For many homeowners, it makes more sense to get a shingle roof replacement. But if you’re in the market for a premium roofing material, let’s talk about what your new metal roof could cost you.The material and labor costs for a corrugated metal roof replacement fall between $7 and $12 per square foot. Since the average roof is roughly 1,700 square feet, we could say that the average cost of a 5V metal roof is between $11,900 and $20,400. This puts it in the moderate-to-high roof replacement cost category.The numbers for standing seam metal roofs are quite different. These metal roof replacements cost between $10 and $35 per square foot. Using that same measurement for the average roof, your roof replacement could cost between $17,000 and $59,500. This is more solidly in the category of high-cost roof replacements.You may have noticed that these ranges are incredibly wide. That’s partially because roofing costs always vary due to individual roofing factors like accessibility or hills and valleys on a roof. But it’s also because metal roofing costs vary depending on the type of metal used.There are plenty of metal roofing options in Florida, from Galvalume to aluminum. But the only way to account for these niche choices is through a personalized roofing cost estimate.

			IN THE KNOW		
		 Metal Roof Replacement FAQs 
		

	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Will a metal roof increase my energy bills in the summer?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, metal roofs do not attract any more heat than other roofing materials so they will not increase your energy bill. On the contrary, they’re better at reflecting UV rays than most shingle roofs. In this way, they can actually save you money.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What kind of aesthetic do exposed fastener metal roofs have?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Some have described the style of 5V roofing as rugged or industrial. However, some homeowners like having a more unique roof and think it provides a fun juxtaposition with the rest of their property.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do metal roofs attract lightning?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tampa Bay is famous for its thunderstorms. But the good news is that they won’t pose any additional danger to you once you get a metal roof. Metal roofs attracting lightning is an old myth, and in fact they’re so noncombustible that lightning striking your metal roof wouldn’t even start a fire.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs rust?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Nearly any metal roof can rust. However, galvanized steel is coated in a rust-resistant alloy to prevent exactly this issue. If you live within a mile of the coast, you may need to use aluminum instead to prevent rust due to the saltwater air.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Like most roofs, crimped metal roofing does need some maintenance. This maintenance is mostly centered around keeping the fasteners water-tight and protected against the elements. However, shingle roofs often run into issues like missing shingles, so there’s no reason to think of exposed fastener metal roofs as unique for needing maintenance.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs noisier in the rain?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Metal roofs can be a little noisier in the rain. However, the difference is minimal, and with proper insulation, your roof shouldn’t be much louder than a shingle roof in the rain.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs hurricane-proof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No roof in the world is immune to hurricanes. However, metal roofs do hold up well against the worst that hurricanes have to offer. So while we can’t guarantee that any roof could withstand a direct Category 5 hurricane, we can tell you that when it comes to holding out against hurricanes, very few materials perform as well as metal roofing.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are exposed fastener metal roofs prone to leaks?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Although the fasteners are exposed, modern washers and sealing techniques are designed to prevent leaks. However, over time, the fasteners and washers may wear down and require periodic replacement to maintain water-tightness.

### A Complete Guide to Tile Roofing in Florida

Did you know that Florida is one of the best places in the country to get a tile roof? With centuries of local history, tile roofs are an essential piece of Florida culture. But despite this long history, many local homeowners still have questions about tile roofs.We’re here to answer them! PITCH Roofing is a company founded on roofing expertise and honesty — two things that the local roofing industry could use more of. Today, we’re using our roofing knowledge to answer all of the questions you have about getting a tile roof replacement in Florida!What Are Tile Roofs?If you’ve lived in Florida for any length of time, then you’ve seen tile roofs around. Usually coming in either earth tones or their signature red, tiles are strategically layered to offer the best aesthetics and protection.Tiles come in many different styles, from French to Mediterranean to mission tiles. They all have their own differences and features, but the general idea is that they create a water-resistant barrier that moves water off your roof without allowing it to reach your vulnerable roof decking.You may not know, though, that tile roofs come in different materials. To help you decide which is best for your roof, let’s talk about your tile roof material options!Clay Tile RoofsThink of clay tiles as the classic option. These timeless, all-natural tiles are baked in a kiln to ensure that they’re hardy and ready to stand up to the Florida elements. In addition to resisting water and pests, clay tile roofs can handle winds of 150 mph or more.With clay tiles, regardless of style, you’ll have a roof that evokes a sense of classic luxury. These roofs are especially popular among people with Spanish-style homes. By adding on a complementary clay tile, you can greatly increase your home’s curb appeal!But while clay tile roofs are both tough and beautiful, those aren’t the biggest reasons that people choose these roofs. Rather, people pick clay tile roofs for their longevity. With proper maintenance, a clay tile roof can last for a century or more. That’s an unbeatable feature that you won’t find in many other roofs!Concrete Tile RoofsIn recent years, concrete tiles have been a way for millions of homeowners to save money on a tile roof replacement. As a durable substitute, concrete tiles are just as strong and hardy as clay tiles. In some ways, they’re even stronger, both with their 200 mph wind resistance and their improved resistance to impact damage.Naturally, the goal of concrete tile is to recreate the look of clay tile, so there aren’t many large aesthetic differences. One added feature of concrete tiles, however, is that they can be painted. This allows you to pick an unconventional color for your new tile roof if you’re not a fan of the classic neutral tones that tile is known for.Despite these advantages, though, concrete tile roofs just can’t match clay tile roofs when it comes to longevity. That said, their 50-year lifespan is still nothing to sneeze at. This still amounts to twice the lifespan of your average shingle roof, so you can still get a long-lasting tile roof without the high up-front costs of clay tiles.Tile Roof Replacement Videohttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6lEgLw6aIdQ

Cost of a Tile Roof Replacement in FloridaCost is always an important factor in roof replacements. But it’s especially relevant for tile roofs since they are a premium roofing material that comes at a premium cost.How much your new tile roof costs will depend largely on the type of tile you choose. The style of the tile will matter to some extent, but the biggest factor in your tile roof replacement costs will come down to the material of the tiles.Let’s start by looking at clay roofing tiles. For the material and installation, clay tile costs between $12 and $21 per square foot. For a 2,000-square-foot roof, that means your tile roof replacement will cost between $24,000 and $42,000. These high costs are why many people opt for concrete tile roofs instead.And the good news is that concrete tile is notably more affordable. Material and installation costs run between $9 and $19 per square foot for concrete roofing tiles. For that same 2,000-square-foot roof, your concrete tile roof replacement would cost between $18,000 and $38,000.As you can see, a tile roof replacement is never going to be the most affordable option on the market. But if you’re in a position to make this investment in your property, we encourage you to consider it. While tile roof costs are high in Florida, they’re still worth it if you want a roof that will raise your property value and protect your home for decades.Schedule Your Free Tile Roof Replacement EstimateDeciding to get a new tile roof is a big deal. 			IN THE KNOW		
		 FAQs About Tile Roofs in Florida 
		

	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best kind of tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no “best” type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I walk on my tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Technically, you can walk on a tile roof. But we would not recommend that you do. While tiles can support a lot of weight, they’re brittle and can easily crack or shatter while people walk on them, which is bad for your roof and very dangerous for whoever is walking on it.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are tile roofs expensive?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

BE IN THE KNOW
FAQs About Roofing Materials


	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Will a metal roof increase my energy bills in the summer?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, metal roofs do not attract any more heat than other roofing materials so they will not increase your energy bill. On the contrary, they’re better at reflecting UV rays than most shingle roofs. In this way, they can actually save you money.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best kind of tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no “best” type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What roofing materials can PITCH work with?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you need a roof repair or a full roof replacement, Pitch’s expert crews have mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This ensures that no matter what your vision for the perfect roof is, we can make sure that you get it. Our most popular roofing materials include:

Asphalt and composite shingles
Clay and concrete roofing tiles
Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
Flat roofing options (TPO, EDPM, modified bitumen, etc.)

With all of these options, we know that we can meet your goals for both aesthetics and protection. To further discuss our extensive style and color options, give us a call our fill out our contact form!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What if I don’t know what my roof needs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem! If you’ve noticed that something isn’t quite right with your roof, maybe a leak or signs of pests, but you aren’t sure what the problem is, call the experts at Pitch. We’ve seen it all, so we’ll be able to quickly diagnose what’s wrong with your roof and walk you through your options for a long-term solution.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	The truth is that nobody knows how much the “average” roof costs in Florida, because there’s no such thing as an average roof. Every roof is unique, and the cost to fix or replace it will be just as individual as your structure is. That said, we can help you get a ballpark figure! Check out our guide to roof replacement costs for a rough idea of how much a new roof can cost in Florida.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do metal roofs attract lightning?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tampa Bay is famous for its thunderstorms. But the good news is that they won’t pose any additional danger to you once you get a metal roof. Metal roofs attracting lightning is an old myth, and in fact they’re so noncombustible that lightning striking your metal roof wouldn’t even start a fire.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs have good insulation?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Generally, most flat roofs don’t automatically come with great insulation. But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are tile roofs expensive?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

### A Floridian's Guide to Shingle Roofs

Looking to get a new shingle roof in Florida? You’ve come to the right place! PITCH Roofing was founded on a bedrock of roofing knowledge, expertise, and commitment to our customers. So when it’s time to get a shingle roof replacement, PITCH is the local roofing company that you should choose.But let’s not get ahead of ourselves. Before we get too into how we can help you get a new shingle roof, we want to answer all of the questions you have about shingle roofing. Let’s start with covering the basics of shingles and all the different types you can choose from!Roofing Shingles 101Many homeowners are surprised to learn that there are so many different types of shingle roofing on the market. Generally speaking, a shingle is any roofing material that covers the roof in an overlapping pattern to prevent damage and is hammered into place.The most common type of roofing shingle is asphalt. This type of shingle is made of asphalt and a layer of support material, usually fiberglass, and the shingle itself is then coated in protective granules to better protect your structure.But there are many different types of shingles, both asphalt and shingles of other compositions. To make sure you’re properly informed for this major decision, let’s talk about the kinds of shingles you can have installed on your roof!Architectural ShinglesThese asphalt shingles are made of several layers of asphalt and support, making them hardy and durable enough to withstand even Florida’s weather patterns. Architectural asphalt shingles are usually approved for winds of up to 110 mph, and they can also resist rain and humidity, two of the biggest roof killers in Florida.Architectural shingles also offer great aesthetics. Whereas old, 3-tab asphalt shingles were flat and didn’t look great on roofs, architectural shingles pop. In fact, they’re also called dimensional shingles thanks to their unique patterning that creates depth and visual interest across your roof.With proper installation and maintenance, architectural asphalt shingles can last for 20-25 years. This is considered “average” in the roofing industry — neither a short life for your roof but also not impressively long. But if you’re on a budget and need a high-quality shingle roof replacement, architectural shingles could be just what you need.Luxury ShinglesAs the name implies, luxury shingles are an upgraded form of asphalt shingles. They’re even thicker than architectural shingles, which makes them better able to resist wind uplift and being soaked through. In fact, they’re designed to withstand winds of up to 130 mph!Luxury shingles don’t look much like shingles, though. Instead, they replicate the look of slate roofing. Thanks to their thickness and detailed designs, they look like a slate roof at a much better cost.If you’re looking for a shingle roof that will last, luxury shingles could be exactly what you need. You can expect this hardy roof to last for up to 40 years! That’s great longevity that will keep your structure dry, protected, and looking great for decades to come.Composite ShinglesUnlike the other items on this list, composite shingles are not made with asphalt. Rather, they’re made with a special synthetic polymer that gives these shingles both great protective features and a specific look. Depending on the type of composite shingle you choose, wind resistance can range from 110 to 150 mph.Similar to luxury shingles, composite shingles are meant to imitate the look of slate or wood shake. This can allow you to get the look of a much more expensive roof at a price more appropriate for a new shingle roof.Thanks to their great protective features, composite shingles can last for a long time. Specifically, you can expect a composite shingle roof to last you about 50 years in Florida. That’s pretty tough to beat in hurricane-prone Florida, and it’s certainly the longest lifespan that you can expect from a shingle roof!		
					Call 727-677-4824				
		The Cost of a New Shingle Roof in FloridaNow that we’ve covered the different types of shingle roofs, it’s time to deal with the next biggest question we get: How much does a shingle roof cost?The reason we encourage people to get free estimates isn’t just so we can talk to you about your new roof. It’s also because roofing costs are highly personalized. A new roof for you could cost twice what it cost your neighbor, or vice versa. This is because roofing costs partially come down to unique roofing features, accessibility, and who installs the roof.But the other largest factor in determining shingle roof costs is the type of shingle being used. We can’t give you an exact quote without seeing your roof for ourselves. But we can show you the average cost of new shingle roofs in Florida:Architectural Shingles: These affordable shingles cost around $5 to $9 per square foot. In other words, on the “average” roof of 1,700 square feet, a new architectural shingle roof would cost $8,500 to $15,300.Luxury Shingles: This premium roofing material is more expensive at $8 to $17 per square foot. On the average roof, that’s $13,600 to $28,900.Composite Shingles: These shingles fall in the middle with costs between $7 and $14 per square foot. With average shingle roofing costs of $11,900 to $24,300, this is a moderately-to-high-priced roofing material.You may have noticed that these ranges are quite large, and you’re right. That’s because there are so many factors to account for that we simply can’t know without looking at your roof. To get a reliable number for your total shingle roof replacement costs, you’ll have to start collecting estimates from reputable roofers.Get Your Free Shingle Roof Replacement Cost EstimateAs you look at local shingle roof options, you’ll probably notice that a lot of roofers claim to be the best in Florida. And we could tell you about our founders’ 60 years of experience or our unmatched customer service, but at the end of the day, that’s all just talk. We’d rather show you how we do business.Get a free, no-obligation shingle roofing estimate from Pitch and see for yourself how we stand out! All you have to do is call us at 727-677-4824 or fill out our contact form online. We’ll then quickly come to give your roof an inspection and prepare a personalized estimate that’s tailored to your wants and your roof.At PITCH, all of our estimates are transparent and comprehensive. That means no hidden fees waiting to surprise you after the final inspection! We believe in honest, transparent business, and that’s exactly what you can expect from us.So get your free shingle roof estimate and see for yourself what all the hype is about. 				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What maintenance do shingle roofs need?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In Florida, maintenance is an especially important part of keeping your shingle roof healthy. Routine maintenance includes cleaning gutters, cleaning off any algae or mold that starts to develop, and replacing any shingles that are damaged or removed by the elements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

### Privacy Policy

Last updated March 11, 2025
This Privacy Notice for PITCH Roofing ("we," "us," or "our"), describes how and why we might access, collect, store, use, and/or share ("process") your personal information when you use our services ("Services"), including when you:

Visit our website at pitchroofing.com, or any website of ours that links to this Privacy Notice

 

Engage with us in other related ways, including any sales, marketing, or events

Questions or concerns? Reading this Privacy Notice will help you understand your privacy rights and choices. We are responsible for making decisions about how your personal information is processed. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our Services. If you still have any questions or concerns, please contact us at hello@pitchroofing.com.
SUMMARY OF KEY POINTS
This summary provides key points from our Privacy Notice, but you can find out more details about any of these topics by clicking the link following each key point or by using our table of contents below to find the section you are looking for.
 
What personal information do we process? When you visit, use, or navigate our Services, we may process personal information depending on how you interact with us and the Services, the choices you make, and the products and features you use. Learn more about personal information you disclose to us.
 
Do we process any sensitive personal information? Some of the information may be considered "special" or "sensitive" in certain jurisdictions, for example your racial or ethnic origins, sexual orientation, and religious beliefs. We do not process sensitive personal information.
 
Do we collect any information from third parties? We may collect information from public databases, marketing partners, social media platforms, and other outside sources. Learn more about information collected from other sources.
 
How do we process your information? We process your information to provide, improve, and administer our Services, communicate with you, for security and fraud prevention, and to comply with law. We may also process your information for other purposes with your consent. We process your information only when we have a valid legal reason to do so. Learn more about how we process your information.
 
In what situations and with which types of parties do we share personal information? We may share information in specific situations and with specific categories of third parties. Learn more about when and with whom we share your personal information.
 
How do we keep your information safe? We have adequate organizational and technical processes and procedures in place to protect your personal information. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure, so we cannot promise or guarantee that hackers, cybercriminals, or other unauthorized third parties will not be able to defeat our security and improperly collect, access, steal, or modify your information. Learn more about how we keep your information safe.
 
What are your rights? Depending on where you are located geographically, the applicable privacy law may mean you have certain rights regarding your personal information. Learn more about your privacy rights.
 
How do you exercise your rights? The easiest way to exercise your rights is by submitting a data subject access request, or by contacting us. We will consider and act upon any request in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
 
Want to learn more about what we do with any information we collect? Review the Privacy Notice in full.

1. WHAT INFORMATION DO WE COLLECT?
Personal information you disclose to us
In Short: We collect personal information that you provide to us.
 We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you express an interest in obtaining information about us or our products and Services, when you participate in activities on the Services, or otherwise when you contact us.
 
Personal Information Provided by You. The personal information that we collect depends on the context of your interactions with us and the Services, the choices you make, and the products and features you use. The personal information we collect may include the following:

names
phone numbers
email addresses
job titles
mailing addresses

Sensitive Information. We do not process sensitive information.
 
All personal information that you provide to us must be true, complete, and accurate, and you must notify us of any changes to such personal information.
Information automatically collected
In Short: Some information — such as your Internet Protocol (IP) address and/or browser and device characteristics — is collected automatically when you visit our Services.
 We automatically collect certain information when you visit, use, or navigate the Services. This information does not reveal your specific identity (like your name or contact information) but may include device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location, information about how and when you use our Services, and other technical information. This information is primarily needed to maintain the security and operation of our Services, and for our internal analytics and reporting purposes. 
 
Like many businesses, we also collect information through cookies and similar technologies. 
 
The information we collect includes:

Log and Usage Data. Log and usage data is service-related, diagnostic, usage, and performance information our servers automatically collect when you access or use our Services and which we record in log files. Depending on how you interact with us, this log data may include your IP address, device information, browser type, and settings and information about your activity in the Services (such as the date/time stamps associated with your usage, pages and files viewed, searches, and other actions you take such as which features you use), device event information (such as system activity, error reports (sometimes called "crash dumps"), and hardware settings).

 

Device Data. We collect device data such as information about your computer, phone, tablet, or other device you use to access the Services. Depending on the device used, this device data may include information such as your IP address (or proxy server), device and application identification numbers, location, browser type, hardware model, Internet service provider and/or mobile carrier, operating system, and system configuration information.

 

Location Data. We collect location data such as information about your device's location, which can be either precise or imprecise. How much information we collect depends on the type and settings of the device you use to access the Services. For example, we may use GPS and other technologies to collect geolocation data that tells us your current location (based on your IP address). You can opt out of allowing us to collect this information either by refusing access to the information or by disabling your Location setting on your device. However, if you choose to opt out, you may not be able to use certain aspects of the Services.

 
Google API
Our use of information received from Google APIs will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
 
Information collected from other sources
In Short: We may collect limited data from public databases, marketing partners, and other outside sources.
 
In order to enhance our ability to provide relevant marketing, offers, and services to you and update our records, we may obtain information about you from other sources, such as public databases, joint marketing partners, affiliate programs, data providers, and from other third parties. This information includes mailing addresses, job titles, email addresses, phone numbers, intent data (or user behavior data), Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, social media profiles, social media URLs, and custom profiles, for purposes of targeted advertising and event promotion.

5. HOW LONG DO WE KEEP YOUR INFORMATION?
In Short: We keep your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Notice unless otherwise required by law.
 
We will only keep your personal information for as long as it is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Notice, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law (such as tax, accounting, or other legal requirements).
 
When we have no ongoing legitimate business need to process your personal information, we will either delete or anonymize such information, or, if this is not possible (for example, because your personal information has been stored in backup archives), then we will securely store your personal information and isolate it from any further processing until deletion is possible.
 
6. HOW DO WE KEEP YOUR INFORMATION SAFE?
In Short: We aim to protect your personal information through a system of organizational and technical security measures.
 
We have implemented appropriate and reasonable technical and organizational security measures designed to protect the security of any personal information we process. However, despite our safeguards and efforts to secure your information, no electronic transmission over the Internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure, so we cannot promise or guarantee that hackers, cybercriminals, or other unauthorized third parties will not be able to defeat our security and improperly collect, access, steal, or modify your information. Although we will do our best to protect your personal information, transmission of personal information to and from our Services is at your own risk. You should only access the Services within a secure environment.
 
7. DO WE COLLECT INFORMATION FROM MINORS?
In Short: We do not knowingly collect data from or market to children under 18 years of age.
 
We do not knowingly collect, solicit data from, or market to children under 18 years of age, nor do we knowingly sell such personal information. By using the Services, you represent that you are at least 18 or that you are the parent or guardian of such a minor and consent to such minor dependent’s use of the Services. If we learn that personal information from users less than 18 years of age has been collected, we will deactivate the account and take reasonable measures to promptly delete such data from our records. If you become aware of any data we may have collected from children under age 18, please contact us at hello@pitchroofing.com.
 
8. WHAT ARE YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS?
In Short:  You may review, change, or terminate your account at any time, depending on your country, province, or state of residence.
 
Withdrawing your consent: If we are relying on your consent to process your personal information, which may be express and/or implied consent depending on the applicable law, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us by using the contact details provided in the section "HOW CAN YOU CONTACT US ABOUT THIS NOTICE?" below.
 
However, please note that this will not affect the lawfulness of the processing before its withdrawal nor, when applicable law allows, will it affect the processing of your personal information conducted in reliance on lawful processing grounds other than consent.
 
Opting out of marketing and promotional communications: You can unsubscribe from our marketing and promotional communications at any time by clicking on the unsubscribe link in the emails that we send, replying "STOP" or "UNSUBSCRIBE" to the SMS messages that we send, or by contacting us using the details provided in the section "HOW CAN YOU CONTACT US ABOUT THIS NOTICE?" below. You will then be removed from the marketing lists. However, we may still communicate with you — for example, to send you service-related messages that are necessary for the administration and use of your account, to respond to service requests, or for other non-marketing purposes.
 
No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Information sharing to subcontractors in support services, such as customer service, is permitted. All other use case categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with third parties.
 
Cookies and similar technologies: Most Web browsers are set to accept cookies by default. If you prefer, you can usually choose to set your browser to remove cookies and to reject cookies. If you choose to remove cookies or reject cookies, this could affect certain features or services of our Services. 
 
If you have questions or comments about your privacy rights, you may email us at hello@pitchroofing.com.
 
9. CONTROLS FOR DO-NOT-TRACK FEATURES
Most web browsers and some mobile operating systems and mobile applications include a Do-Not-Track ("DNT") feature or setting you can activate to signal your privacy preference not to have data about your online browsing activities monitored and collected. At this stage, no uniform technology standard for recognizing and implementing DNT signals has been finalized. As such, we do not currently respond to DNT browser signals or any other mechanism that automatically communicates your choice not to be tracked online. If a standard for online tracking is adopted that we must follow in the future, we will inform you about that practice in a revised version of this Privacy Notice.
 
California law requires us to let you know how we respond to web browser DNT signals. Because there currently is not an industry or legal standard for recognizing or honoring DNT signals, we do not respond to them at this time.

Depending upon the state where you live, you may also have the following rights:

Right to opt out of the collection of sensitive data and personal data collected through the operation of a voice or facial recognition feature (as permitted by applicable law, including Florida’s privacy law)

How to Exercise Your Rights
To exercise these rights, you can contact us by submitting a data subject access request, by emailing us at hello@pitchroofing.com, or by referring to the contact details at the bottom of this document.
Under certain US state data protection laws, you can designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf. We may deny a request from an authorized agent that does not submit proof that they have been validly authorized to act on your behalf in accordance with applicable laws.
Request Verification
Upon receiving your request, we will need to verify your identity to determine you are the same person about whom we have the information in our system. We will only use personal information provided in your request to verify your identity or authority to make the request. However, if we cannot verify your identity from the information already maintained by us, we may request that you provide additional information for the purposes of verifying your identity and for security or fraud-prevention purposes.
If you submit the request through an authorized agent, we may need to collect additional information to verify your identity before processing your request and the agent will need to provide a written and signed permission from you to submit such request on your behalf.
Appeals
Under certain US state data protection laws, if we decline to take action regarding your request, you may appeal our decision by emailing us at hello@pitchroofing.com. We will inform you in writing of any action taken or not taken in response to the appeal, including a written explanation of the reasons for the decisions. If your appeal is denied, you may submit a complaint to your state attorney general.
 
11. DO WE MAKE UPDATES TO THIS NOTICE?
In Short: Yes, we will update this notice as necessary to stay compliant with relevant laws.
 
We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated "Revised" date at the top of this Privacy Notice. If we make material changes to this Privacy Notice, we may notify you either by prominently posting a notice of such changes or by directly sending you a notification. We encourage you to review this Privacy Notice frequently to be informed of how we are protecting your information.

If you have questions or comments about this notice, you may email us at hello@pitchroofing.com or contact us by post at:
