13. HOW CAN YOU REVIEW, UPDATE, OR DELETE THE DATA WE COLLECT FROM YOU?
You have the right to request access to the personal information we collect from you, details about how we have processed it, correct inaccuracies, or delete your personal information. You may also have the right to withdraw your consent to our processing of your personal information. These rights may be limited in some circumstances by applicable law. To request to review, update, or delete your personal information, please fill out and submit a data subject access request.

### Tampa

Have you looked at the state of roofing in Tampa recently? We have, and we didn’t like what we saw. Yes, there are great roofers in Tampa, but there are just as many scam roofing companies in Hillsborough County that promise the world and leave their clients with nothing but disappointment and a shoddy roof.

But that’s not how we do business. We’re PITCH, a local roofing company that believes in high-quality workmanship and complete transparency with our customers. Today, we want to talk to you about what we can do when you need the best roofing contractors in Tampa.

But before we talk about our local roofing services, let us tell you a bit more about who we are. We wouldn’t trust strangers on our roofs either, so we’ll tell you all about Pitch and why we’re Tampa’s favorite roofing company.
The Story of Tampa’s Best Roofing Company
You may have noticed that many roofing companies serve Tampa, but none of them have our history. Pitch was formed by veteran construction professionals who closely examined the roofing scene around them. To put it simply, they didn’t like what they saw.

Everywhere they looked, there were storm chasers, inexperienced subcontractors, and terrible communication between roofers and clients. And the people paying the price were the customers. So they put together their 60 years of local roofing experience and decided to create the solution.

We’re that solution. All of our Tampa roofing services are rooted in great workmanship, complete transparency with our customers, and most importantly, dependability at every step of the roofing process. And thanks to our foundation of decades of experience roofing in and around Hillsborough County, we know how to Florida-proof a roof better than anyone.

Now that you know who we are, let’s talk about something much more important: what we can do for you.

Hillsborough County Roof Repairs
Living between the Gulf of Mexico and Tampa Bay, plenty of things can go wrong with your roof. And over our decades of Tampa roofing experience, we’ve handled just about every kind of roof repair you can imagine. Some of the most common roofing issues we see in Tampa are:

 	Roof leaks
 	Roof sagging
 	Damaged flashing
 	Pooling water
 	Missing or damaged shingles

The truth is that between high humidity, extreme sun exposure, and the occasional hurricane, virtually any part of your roofing system could fail. That’s why you need experienced Tampa roofers who know what your roof is up against and how to restore it to maximum strength.

And with Pitch, you never have to worry about us leaving the job unfinished. We don’t do patch jobs that fix the problem today but allow it to come back in a couple months. Instead, we provide lasting solutions to your problems. Because isn’t that what local roofing partners are for?

Tampa Roof Replacements
Even with the best repairs and maintenance, every roof needs replacing sooner or later. While roof replacements are a big investment to be taken seriously, this is also an opportunity for fun. After all, it’s a chance to customize your home or business and have it better suit your vision!

That’s why we offer a wide variety of roof replacement materials. We know that everyone has their own idea of the “best” roof, so we make sure that all of our customers can get what they’re looking for. Some of the materials we use most often for Tampa roof replacements include:

 	Asphalt and composite shingles
 	Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
 	Clay and concrete roofing tiles
 	Flat roofing materials like TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen

When we’re replacing your roof, we’re focusing on three things: setting your new roof up for success, making sure it looks exactly how you want, and clearly communicating the process to you so you always know the status of your property. Nobody likes uncertainty with a major investment in their property; that’s why we’re always clear and transparent with our customers.

### FAQs

BE INFORMED
BASIC ROOFING FAQs
Do you have questions about roof replacements and repairs? You're not the only one. In fact, we get so many questions from Florida property owners that we decided to go ahead and make a roofing FAQ for you! Whether you're trying to decide on a roof repair vs replacement or you're just not clear on how the roofing process works, we've got you covered.

As your partners in local roofing, we're here to answer all of your questions. Feel free to reach out to our friendly customer service team if your question isn't included below, but first, let's review some of the most common questions that Floridians have for our team of veteran local roofers!



	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best kind of tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no “best” type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What roofing materials can PITCH work with?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you need a roof repair or a full roof replacement, Pitch’s expert crews have mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This ensures that no matter what your vision for the perfect roof is, we can make sure that you get it. Our most popular roofing materials include:

Asphalt and composite shingles
Clay and concrete roofing tiles
Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
Flat roofing options (TPO, EDPM, modified bitumen, etc.)

With all of these options, we know that we can meet your goals for both aesthetics and protection. To further discuss our extensive style and color options, give us a call our fill out our contact form!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What maintenance do shingle roofs need?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In Florida, maintenance is an especially important part of keeping your shingle roof healthy. Routine maintenance includes cleaning gutters, cleaning off any algae or mold that starts to develop, and replacing any shingles that are damaged or removed by the elements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What kind of aesthetic do exposed fastener metal roofs have?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Some have described the style of 5V roofing as rugged or industrial. However, some homeowners like having a more unique roof and think it provides a fun juxtaposition with the rest of their property.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What if I don’t know what my roof needs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem! If you’ve noticed that something isn’t quite right with your roof, maybe a leak or signs of pests, but you aren’t sure what the problem is, call the experts at Pitch. We’ve seen it all, so we’ll be able to quickly diagnose what’s wrong with your roof and walk you through your options for a long-term solution.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Should I take out a home equity loan or get roof financing?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you should take a HELOC or get roof financing depends on your unique financial situation. Home equity loans usually have lower interest rates, but they’re not available to everyone, and you risk losing your home if you default. Roof financing, on the other hand, is faster to acquire, so it’s ideal for situations where you need immediate roofing services.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much of a down payment do I need to finance a roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Down payments vary widely depending on your payment plan. Some financing plans might require 20% of the total costs upfront, while others might offer 100% financing with no upfront costs.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	The truth is that nobody knows how much the “average” roof costs in Florida, because there’s no such thing as an average roof. Every roof is unique, and the cost to fix or replace it will be just as individual as your structure is. That said, we can help you get a ballpark figure! Check out our guide to roof replacement costs for a rough idea of how much a new roof can cost in Florida.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long can I finance my roof replacement?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Specific financing terms often come down to a case-by-case basis. That said, roof financing tends to last anywhere from 12 months to 10 years, depending on the amount of money loaned and your specific financing choices.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How can I find out how much your roofing services cost?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In a perfect world, we’d be able to tell you over the phone how much your roofing services will cost. But to know the exact dimensions, accessibility, and state of your roof, we just can’t identify an accurate number. But we’re not going to settle for just giving a rough estimate.
For a detailed, accurate roofing estimate, all you have to do is give us a call and tell us you’d like an estimate! Or, if you’d prefer, you can fill out our contact form and let our friendly customer service professionals get back to you. Once your estimate has been scheduled, one of our roofing pros will inspect your roof and prepare an estimate that suits your roof and gives you exactly what you’re looking for. The best part? With Pitch, you never have to worry about hidden fees! Transparent estimates are how we earn our community’s trust, so we always include the full scope of work to be done on your roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do I need good credit to get a new roof financed in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Good credit is always helpful in getting the lowest possible rate for your roof financing. But almost all roofers work with people who don’t have perfect credit, and this shouldn’t stop you from getting a good rate on your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs have good insulation?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Generally, most flat roofs don’t automatically come with great insulation. But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs rust?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Nearly any metal roof can rust. However, galvanized steel is coated in a rust-resistant alloy to prevent exactly this issue. If you live within a mile of the coast, you may need to use aluminum instead to prevent rust due to the saltwater air.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Like most roofs, crimped metal roofing does need some maintenance. This maintenance is mostly centered around keeping the fasteners water-tight and protected against the elements. However, shingle roofs often run into issues like missing shingles, so there’s no reason to think of exposed fastener metal roofs as unique for needing maintenance.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I only get a shingle roof financed?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, and in fact there are plenty of metal roofing companies that take payments near you. Roof financing is available for all roofing materials, including flat roofs, so don’t let your immediate budget decide the quality or type of your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can hurricane straps lower my homeowners insurance premiums?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, many insurance companies see hurricane straps as a way to reduce the risk of storm damage, which can lower your premiums. It’s best to check with your insurance provider for specific discounts.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are tile roofs expensive?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are PITCH Roofing crews licensed and insured?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, all of our crews are made up of experienced roofers who are licensed and insured to work on your roof. What’s more, we don’t send inexperienced subcontractors to cut costs. When we send a crew out to your home or business to complete a job for you, you can rest assured that everyone involved is licensed, insured, and an expert in your chosen roofing material.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs noisier in the rain?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Metal roofs can be a little noisier in the rain. However, the difference is minimal, and with proper insulation, your roof shouldn’t be much louder than a shingle roof in the rain.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs hurricane-proof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No roof in the world is immune to hurricanes. However, metal roofs do hold up well against the worst that hurricanes have to offer. So while we can’t guarantee that any roof could withstand a direct Category 5 hurricane, we can tell you that when it comes to holding out against hurricanes, very few materials perform as well as metal roofing.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are exposed fastener metal roofs prone to leaks?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Although the fasteners are exposed, modern washers and sealing techniques are designed to prevent leaks. However, over time, the fasteners and washers may wear down and require periodic replacement to maintain water-tightness.

			IN THE KNOW		
		 Financing FAQs 
		

	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Should I take out a home equity loan or get roof financing?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you should take a HELOC or get roof financing depends on your unique financial situation. Home equity loans usually have lower interest rates, but they’re not available to everyone, and you risk losing your home if you default. Roof financing, on the other hand, is faster to acquire, so it’s ideal for situations where you need immediate roofing services.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Is it better to pay for a roof replacement upfront or finance it?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	If you can, it’s cheaper to pay for a roof replacement yourself. That’s because when you pay upfront, you don’t have to worry about additional fees or interest. However, this isn’t an option for all homeowners. And financing a roof replacement can be much cheaper than keeping a damaged roof on your home, especially during hurricane season! If your roof fails, it could put your entire structure in jeopardy.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much of a down payment do I need to finance a roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Down payments vary widely depending on your payment plan. Some financing plans might require 20% of the total costs upfront, while others might offer 100% financing with no upfront costs.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long can I finance my roof replacement?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Specific financing terms often come down to a case-by-case basis. That said, roof financing tends to last anywhere from 12 months to 10 years, depending on the amount of money loaned and your specific financing choices.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long can I finance a roof replacement for?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Loan terms for roof replacement typically range from 1 to 15 years, depending on the type of financing and the lender’s terms. Paying your loan off more slowly will mean spending more in the long term but with a lower monthly payment. Conversely, paying off a loan quickly is cheaper overall but requires a higher monthly payment.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do I need good credit to get a new roof financed in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Good credit is always helpful in getting the lowest possible rate for your roof financing. But almost all roofers work with people who don’t have perfect credit, and this shouldn’t stop you from getting a good rate on your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I only get a shingle roof financed?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, and in fact there are plenty of metal roofing companies that take payments near you. Roof financing is available for all roofing materials, including flat roofs, so don’t let your immediate budget decide the quality or type of your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I get roof replacement financing with bad credit?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, in almost all cases, you will be able to finance a roof replacement even with bad credit. However, you may not qualify for the best rates. One option to get good rates with bad credit is to have a co-signer with a higher credit score.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I finance a roof replacement with a credit card?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, it is possible to put your roof replacement on your credit card. However, this is possibly the most expensive option for roof replacement financing. With APRs much higher than conventional loan rates, putting your roof on a credit card could cost you a lot of money in the long run.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are there special options for roof replacement financing for veterans and seniors?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, there are many programs that help with roof replacement costs for veterans and seniors. However, since these are often private programs, they often depend largely on where you live and your unique circumstances. To learn more about these programs in your area, we recommend contacting your local VA office or elder support services.

### Sarasota County

Sarasota County is renowned for its beauty and coastal charm, but its location along Florida’s western coast also puts it at a high risk for severe weather incidents. As a result, Sarasota County roofing services need to provide an especially high level of protection.

Providing that protection is exactly why PITCH was made. We were founded by veteran local roofers who saw the state of the roofing industry in Florida and decided to make a change. With quality workmanship and exceptional customer service as the heart of our business model, there’s no limit to what we can do for you and your roof. Don't just take our word for it, though — let us show you how we stand out from the pack.
Sarasota County Roofing Services
As a full-service roofing company, we pride ourselves on providing a wide range of roofing services to our local community. Keep reading to see how we can help you improve your home or business!
Roof Replacements in & around Sarasota
When you need a new roof installed, there’s no better choice than Pitch. Our crews are made up of experienced roofing contractors with decades of experience installing various roofing materials, including:

 	Asphalt shingles
 	Composite shingles
 	Clay and concrete roofing tiles
 	Metal roofing sheets
 	Flat roofing options (TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen, etc.)

In addition to our versatility in roofing materials, we can also provide many different style options, from the types of tiles you choose to the color of your new roof. When you choose Pitch, you’re choosing Sarasota County roofers who can give you the perfect roof to protect against Florida’s weather and fulfill your aesthetic vision.
Sarasota Roof Repairs
If you call us for help when you first notice an issue with your roof, we may be able to save you a roof replacement by providing a long-lasting roof repair instead. Because, unlike other roofers, we don’t believe in patch jobs that treat the symptoms but leave the core issue unresolved. Thanks to our commitment to excellence, you can have peace of mind knowing that your roofing problem isn’t going to come back the next time a storm passes through.

At PITCH, we understand that roof repairs almost never come at a good time. That’s why we’ll work with you to discuss your options and make sure that you can get a timely solution to your roofing problems. To us, providing quality, efficient roof repairs is an essential part of our Sarasota County roofing services.

### St. Petersburg

Did you know that the master roofers at PITCH have been working in the roofing industry for over 60 years? These decades of local residential and commercial roofing experience make us uniquely qualified to provide expert roofing services in St. Petersburg, Florida.If you’re looking for roofers based in Pinellas County who know how to Florida-proof your roof, keep reading to see how we can help!St. Petersburg Roof ReplacementsFlorida is famously tough on roofs, and that’s doubly true in St. Petersburg where storms from the Gulf can cause substantial damage. Thankfully, over our decades of local roofing, we’ve learned how to protect your roof against the unpredictable elements.In fact, we’re so good that we can Florida-proof your home or business regardless of what roofing material you want to use. Some of the roofing materials that we use for roof replacements are:Asphalt shinglesComposite shinglesClay and concrete roof tilesMetal roofingFlat roofing materials (EPDM, TPO, modified bitumen, etc.)At PITCH, we understand that you don’t just want a roof that is durable. You also want a roof that generates curb appeal and helps with energy efficiency. And with a variety of color and style options, we know that we can get you a strong, hardy roof that doesn’t compromise on your aesthetic vision. For us, giving you exactly what you want is just a standard part of our roofing services in St. Petersburg!Roof Repairs in Pinellas CountyWith the right roofers, you can get roofing issues fixed early and avoid the hassle of a total roof replacement. And with decades of experience with roof repairs in St. Petersburg, our roofing contractors know how to get to the cause of your problem and apply a long-lasting solution.From leaks to damaged roofing materials to algae, our crew of local roofing experts has seen it all. And unlike other roofers, we don’t drag our feet or leave the job half-finished. Instead, we work efficiently to prevent further damage and stop the problem at its source. This way, you don’t have to worry about a problem reappearing after our crew leaves your property!

		Local Leak Detection ServicesNot sure where that annoying leak is coming from or how much damage there is? Good news: Leak detection is one of our most sought-after roofing services in St. Petersburg!This is a great option if you’ve got a roof leak and want to make sure that there’s no residual damage. Because, unlike some other roofers, we don’t just fix the leak and move on. Instead, we trace the leak back to its source, address it, and determine the full extent of water damage to your roof.If we’re called early enough, we can usually remove any damage with minimal roof repairs. But if your leak has been going on for awhile, we may have to replace all or part of your roof. No matter what we find, though, we’ll be transparent with you every step of the way so that you know what’s going on with your property and what your options are to fix the issue. As your partners in local roofing, we consider it our responsibility to give you back your peace of mind!

				What should be included in a Pinellas County roofing estimate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Generally, you shouldn’t trust roofers who only give you a final number for your roofing estimate. They could be hiding how much they’re charging for certain things, or worse, leaving out essential parts of the job from your estimate. Instead, a good estimate should include the costs of materials, labor, and permitting fees, as well as warranty information and a timeline for the job.

	Which roofing materials your roofers use will vary from company to company. But at Pitch, we pride ourselves on having mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This includes shingles, tiles, and metal roofing, as well as flat roofing options like TPO and EPDM. If you’re ever unsure whether a roofing company uses the material you want, the best thing you can do is ask!

				How long does a roof replacement take in Pinellas County?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your roofing services take will always depend on the unique factors of your roof. But in general, replacing a roof in Pinellas County shouldn’t take more than one to three days if the weather cooperates.

				How do I know if Pinellas County roofers are really licensed and insured?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	You can check a roofer’s license status with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR). To verify their insurance, ask the roofer for a copy of their insurance certificates and verify them with the insurance provider. These extra steps can give you peace of mind when you’re making a major decision!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are there any good roof grants or public funds in Pinellas County?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	When looking for Pinellas County roofers, grants can be a great way to cut costs. The My Safe Florida Home program is a great way to save money on select roofing services, but you should note that this program does not cover roof replacements.

			FAQS		
		 Common Roofing Questions 
		

	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Will my homeowners insurance cover any roof repair costs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Depending on your policy, your homeowners insurance company may cover some or all of your roof repair costs. This typically depends on how your roof was damaged. If a hurricane or tropical storm tore shingles from your roof, your roof repairs may be covered. But most homeowners insurance policies don’t cover wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Will a metal roof increase my energy bills in the summer?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, metal roofs do not attract any more heat than other roofing materials so they will not increase your energy bill. On the contrary, they’re better at reflecting UV rays than most shingle roofs. In this way, they can actually save you money.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

### Our Story

The Best Services For
The Best Clients		At PITCH, we believe a roof isn’t just an accent to a structure: It’s one of the most serious important parts of a property. And we treat it that way.With over 60 years of experience in roofing, we’d become frustrated with the poor quality of service that many contractors provide. So we set out to create a roofing business that people could genuinely rely on: a dedicated team of roofing specialists that bring confidence and peace of mind where you need it most. No time-wasting. No half-measures. Just solid, dependable, high-quality service that exceeds expectations.

			WHO WE ARE		
		 FAST, FRIENDLY, RELIABLE ROOFING 
		At PITCH, we aren’t just another roofing company: We’re your local roofing partners. Because, unlike other roofers, our founders didn’t create this company to make a quick buck. They made it to solve a problem.Between storm chasers coming to Florida and poor communication from local roofers, Floridians just didn't have many good options. So our founders put their 60+ years of roofing experience together and made us: PITCH Roofing. We’re here to do what other roofers won’t and give our community members the world-class roofing services that they deserve.Whether you need to replace some damaged shingles or you need a full roof replacement, we’ve got your back. Our team of local roofing professionals knows Florida roofing inside and out. That makes us able to guarantee a strong, hurricane-resistant roof that also looks great and raises your property’s curb appeal.Our team knows that it’s not just about the work we do on your roof, though. It’s also about how we treat our customers during the roofing process. That’s why we’re committed to 100% open and honest communication, from getting your free roofing estimate to that final inspection.Based right here in the heart of Tampa Bay, our roofers and customer support team are ready to help you. If you’re ready to talk about what our expert team of professionals can do for you, all you have to do is give us a call or fill out our contact form. Give PITCH a chance to earn your business and let us show you how easy roofing can be when you’ve got experienced local pros in your corner!

																												Hurricane season in Florida officially runs from June 1 through November 30 each year. That six-month window brings a higher likelihood of tropical storms and hurricanes forming in the Atlantic basin, and Florida, jutting out between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean, is often in their path. Understanding the timing, intensity, and implications of hurricane season is essential if you want to protect your home and family. Below, we’ll break down what you need to know about hurricane season in Florida and how you can prepare your roof before the rains and winds arrive.Why Florida Is at RiskFlorida’s unique geography places it in the crosshairs of storms that form off the coast of West Africa, travel across the Atlantic, or spin up in the Gulf of Mexico. Peak hurricane activity typically occurs between mid-August and late October, when sea surface temperatures are warmest and atmospheric conditions favor rapid storm development. Even outside the peak months, strong tropical storms have formed as early as June and as late as November, so vigilance is key for the entire season.Historical Patterns and Peak MonthsWhile the official season starts June 1, historical data shows that tropical storm formation gradually increases in July, surges through August and September, and tapers off in October and November.June–July: Early tropical depressions and storms occasionally form, offering an important reminder to check your roof’s condition before the heavy rains begin.August–September: This period marks the height of activity. Nearly 70 percent of cat­egories 3, 4, and 5 hurricanes occur in these two months.October–November: Storms can still be powerful, but they tend to be less frequent as ocean temperatures cool.Signs Your Roof Needs AttentionHigh winds and driving rain expose hidden vulnerabilities—loose shingles, worn underlayment, and compromised flashing. Before hurricane season, look for:Curling or Missing Shingles: These can catch wind like sails and tear free.Granule Loss: Bare spots on shingles reduce UV protection and shorten your roof’s lifespan.Damaged Flashing: Leaks often start around vents, chimneys, and skylights.Clogged Gutters: Overflowing gutters can back water under your roofing materials.If you notice any of these issues, now is the time to act. A thorough inspection and repair can prevent costly water damage when storms arrive.How to Prepare Your RoofReinforce Vulnerable Areas: Upgrading to high-wind rated shingles, installing hurricane straps, or adding sealants around penetrations can make a major difference when gusts exceed 100 mph.Clean and Secure Gutters: Clear debris and ensure downspouts drain away from your foundation.Trim Overhanging Branches: Tree limbs can turn into projectiles in high winds, causing punctures or impact damage.Why Choose PITCH RoofingAt PITCH Roofing, Roofing Done Right is more than a slogan. As a Better Business Bureau accredited contractor and an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, we bring over 60 years of combined expertise to every project. Our five-star reviews reflect our commitment to transparent pricing, expert craftsmanship, and responsive service. When hurricane season approaches, you deserve a partner who understands Florida’s unique challenges and delivers solutions designed to stand up to the strongest storms.Don’t wait until a tropical storm is on the horizon. To schedule your free roof inspection and prepare for hurricane season, call PITCH Roofing today at 727 677 4824. Our friendly team is standing by to help you safeguard your home with durable materials, precise installation, and long-term warranties.Stay Informed and Stay SafeKnowledge is your first line of defense. Bookmark our page—“When Is Hurricane Season in Florida”—for up-to-date weather insights, preparation tips, and community alerts. Between June 1 and November 30, check conditions regularly, review your emergency plan, and trust PITCH Roofing to keep the roof over your head secure.By taking proactive steps now, you can face the season with confidence, knowing your home is ready for whatever Florida weather brings. Schedule your free estimate at 727 677 4824 and experience why homeowners across the Gulf Coast rely on PITCH Roofing for quality, integrity, and peace of mind.

Roof Repair FAQS


	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best kind of tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no “best” type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What roofing materials can PITCH work with?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you need a roof repair or a full roof replacement, Pitch’s expert crews have mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This ensures that no matter what your vision for the perfect roof is, we can make sure that you get it. Our most popular roofing materials include:

Asphalt and composite shingles
Clay and concrete roofing tiles
Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
Flat roofing options (TPO, EDPM, modified bitumen, etc.)

With all of these options, we know that we can meet your goals for both aesthetics and protection. To further discuss our extensive style and color options, give us a call our fill out our contact form!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What maintenance do shingle roofs need?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In Florida, maintenance is an especially important part of keeping your shingle roof healthy. Routine maintenance includes cleaning gutters, cleaning off any algae or mold that starts to develop, and replacing any shingles that are damaged or removed by the elements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What kind of aesthetic do exposed fastener metal roofs have?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Some have described the style of 5V roofing as rugged or industrial. However, some homeowners like having a more unique roof and think it provides a fun juxtaposition with the rest of their property.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What if I don’t know what my roof needs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem! If you’ve noticed that something isn’t quite right with your roof, maybe a leak or signs of pests, but you aren’t sure what the problem is, call the experts at Pitch. We’ve seen it all, so we’ll be able to quickly diagnose what’s wrong with your roof and walk you through your options for a long-term solution.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Should I take out a home equity loan or get roof financing?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you should take a HELOC or get roof financing depends on your unique financial situation. Home equity loans usually have lower interest rates, but they’re not available to everyone, and you risk losing your home if you default. Roof financing, on the other hand, is faster to acquire, so it’s ideal for situations where you need immediate roofing services.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much of a down payment do I need to finance a roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Down payments vary widely depending on your payment plan. Some financing plans might require 20% of the total costs upfront, while others might offer 100% financing with no upfront costs.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	The truth is that nobody knows how much the “average” roof costs in Florida, because there’s no such thing as an average roof. Every roof is unique, and the cost to fix or replace it will be just as individual as your structure is. That said, we can help you get a ballpark figure! Check out our guide to roof replacement costs for a rough idea of how much a new roof can cost in Florida.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long can I finance my roof replacement?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Specific financing terms often come down to a case-by-case basis. That said, roof financing tends to last anywhere from 12 months to 10 years, depending on the amount of money loaned and your specific financing choices.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How can I find out how much your roofing services cost?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In a perfect world, we’d be able to tell you over the phone how much your roofing services will cost. But to know the exact dimensions, accessibility, and state of your roof, we just can’t identify an accurate number. But we’re not going to settle for just giving a rough estimate.
For a detailed, accurate roofing estimate, all you have to do is give us a call and tell us you’d like an estimate! Or, if you’d prefer, you can fill out our contact form and let our friendly customer service professionals get back to you. Once your estimate has been scheduled, one of our roofing pros will inspect your roof and prepare an estimate that suits your roof and gives you exactly what you’re looking for. The best part? With Pitch, you never have to worry about hidden fees! Transparent estimates are how we earn our community’s trust, so we always include the full scope of work to be done on your roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do I need good credit to get a new roof financed in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Good credit is always helpful in getting the lowest possible rate for your roof financing. But almost all roofers work with people who don’t have perfect credit, and this shouldn’t stop you from getting a good rate on your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs have good insulation?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Generally, most flat roofs don’t automatically come with great insulation. But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs rust?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Nearly any metal roof can rust. However, galvanized steel is coated in a rust-resistant alloy to prevent exactly this issue. If you live within a mile of the coast, you may need to use aluminum instead to prevent rust due to the saltwater air.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do exposed fastener metal roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Like most roofs, crimped metal roofing does need some maintenance. This maintenance is mostly centered around keeping the fasteners water-tight and protected against the elements. However, shingle roofs often run into issues like missing shingles, so there’s no reason to think of exposed fastener metal roofs as unique for needing maintenance.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I only get a shingle roof financed?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, and in fact there are plenty of metal roofing companies that take payments near you. Roof financing is available for all roofing materials, including flat roofs, so don’t let your immediate budget decide the quality or type of your new roof.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can hurricane straps lower my homeowners insurance premiums?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, many insurance companies see hurricane straps as a way to reduce the risk of storm damage, which can lower your premiums. It’s best to check with your insurance provider for specific discounts.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are tile roofs expensive?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are PITCH Roofing crews licensed and insured?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, all of our crews are made up of experienced roofers who are licensed and insured to work on your roof. What’s more, we don’t send inexperienced subcontractors to cut costs. When we send a crew out to your home or business to complete a job for you, you can rest assured that everyone involved is licensed, insured, and an expert in your chosen roofing material.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs noisier in the rain?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Metal roofs can be a little noisier in the rain. However, the difference is minimal, and with proper insulation, your roof shouldn’t be much louder than a shingle roof in the rain.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs hurricane-proof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No roof in the world is immune to hurricanes. However, metal roofs do hold up well against the worst that hurricanes have to offer. So while we can’t guarantee that any roof could withstand a direct Category 5 hurricane, we can tell you that when it comes to holding out against hurricanes, very few materials perform as well as metal roofing.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are exposed fastener metal roofs prone to leaks?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Although the fasteners are exposed, modern washers and sealing techniques are designed to prevent leaks. However, over time, the fasteners and washers may wear down and require periodic replacement to maintain water-tightness.

			HOW IT'S DONE		
		 The Roof Replacement Process 
        	
        01
    	  PREPPING YOUR PROPERTY 
													Before starting the roof replacement, PITCH Roofing ensures that your property is well-prepared and protected. We safeguard plants, landscaping, and other delicate areas with protective coverings. Gutters and downspouts are shielded to prevent damage during the work. Additionally, any necessary measures are taken to protect windows, doors, and outdoor furniture. By preparing the site thoroughly, we minimize disruption and ensure a safe, clean working environment throughout the roof replacement process.
        	
        02
    	  ROOF REMOVAL 
													During a roof replacement, our crews remove everything from the old underlayment and flashings to your old roofing material, leaving just your roof decking. By working through each individual layer of your roofing system, we give your new roof the best possible start. This thorough preparation is crucial for laying a solid foundation for the new roof installation, guaranteeing durability and top performance.
        	
        03
    	  PLYWOOD INSPECTION 
													
Once the old roofing material is removed, the PITCH Roofing team conducts a meticulous inspection of your roof’s decking, which may consist of plywood or 1×6 hardboards. This step ensures that everything is up to current building codes and in suitable condition for the new installation. We identify and replace any weak or rotted wood, making necessary corrections to provide a strong, stable foundation for your new roof. This careful preparation helps extend the life of your roof and enhances its overall performance.
        	
        04
    	  WATER BARRIER 
													PITCH Roofing utilizes a high-temperature rated, self-adhering water barrier, strategically installed at critical areas of your roof to ensure maximum protection. This superior product is capable of keeping your roof dry independently, but it primarily serves as a second line of defense against extreme weather conditions. Standard application includes placement in valleys and around roof penetrations. For enhanced resilience, there is an option to upgrade by installing the barrier over the entire roof, thereby creating an exceptionally durable roofing system.
        	
        05
    	  SYNTHETIC UNDERLAYMENT 
													Underlayment is a crucial component of any roofing system, serving a dual purpose. It not only keeps the roof dry during construction but also acts as a long-lasting vapor barrier. At PITCH Roofing, we use a high-strength synthetic underlayment that is 40 times stronger than traditional felt paper. This advanced roofing technology lays flatter and maintains its integrity over time, unlike traditional underlayments, which can degrade. This ensures a more durable and reliable roof for your home.
        	
        06
    	  DRIP EDGE 
													The installation of the drip edge is a key step in constructing your new roof. This component not only strengthens but also protects the perimeter of the roof, laying the groundwork for the subsequent shingle installation. Our standard drip edge is made from 26 gauge metal and is available in five factory-painted colors: black, gray, white, brown, and beige. Additionally, we offer the option to custom fabricate the drip edge in any color you desire, ensuring it perfectly matches your home's aesthetic.
        	
        07
    	  MATERIAL INSTALLATION 
													Your chosen roofing material is the main focal point of your roof, playing a crucial role in keeping your home dry and protected. At Pitch, we tailor our roof installation services to the material and ensure that your roof is properly installed for long-term safety and durability across all parts of your new roofing system. This careful approach helps ensure that your roof is as beautiful as it is functional.
        	
        08
    	  VENT AND PLUMBING FLASHINGS 
													Every home features a unique set of penetrations that emerge through the roof, such as vents and plumbing stacks. We understand that properly waterproofing these penetrations from the outset is crucial to preventing leaks and avoiding future repairs. Our team employs precise techniques and high-quality materials to ensure that each penetration is thoroughly sealed, safeguarding your home against water damage and contributing to the overall longevity of your roof.
We also utilize rodent covers, installed over-top the plumbing penetrations. These guards protect against rodent damage and prevent debris and critters from entering the pipe. They are color-matched to the roof, providing a clean and uniform appearance.
        	
        09
    	  ATTIC VENTILATION 
													Ridge ventilation is a critical feature installed along or near the peaks of the roof, designed to allow excess heat and moisture to escape from the attic space. This not only helps regulate the temperature within your home but also prevents moisture accumulation that can lead to structural damage.
We also carefully calculate the specific ventilation needs of your attic space and employ the best methods to ensure optimal airflow. Our tailored solutions are designed to enhance the efficiency and longevity of your roof, safeguarding your home against potential issues related to poor ventilation.
        	
        10
    	  HIP AND RIDGE CAPS 
													Hip and ridge caps are essential components of a shingle roof, crafted from the same material as the field shingles but specifically designed for use along the peaks and hips. We use these specialized caps to effectively seal the joining sections of a roof, enhancing its overall structural integrity. Additionally, hip and ridge caps contribute to a sleek, finished appearance, ensuring that your roof not only performs excellently but also looks great from every angle.
        	
        11
    	  CLEANUP 
													Our crews understand that the job isn't finished until the site is clean. After completing a roof replacement, our team conducts a thorough cleanup process to ensure your property looks its best. We meticulously remove all debris, nails, and materials from the work area, employing magnetic sweepers to catch any metal objects that might have fallen during the installation. This attention to detail means you can enjoy your new roof without the hassle of post-construction cleanup, ensuring your home and yard are safe and spotless.

### How much does it cost to repair a small roof leak?

Small roof leaks can usually be fixed for under $1,000. However, it’s important to have a professional come look at the issue just to be sure it’s minor. What seems like a minor leak inside the home can sometimes be a sign of larger water damage that you’re not seeing, in which case you may need a more costly roof repair.

### How long do roof repairs take?

Minor roof repairs can be resolved within just a few hours. Larger-scale repairs can take anywhere from one to three days of work, and even longer if the weather doesn’t cooperate.

### Can I DIY my roof repairs?

Technically speaking, there may be some minor roof repairs that a handy layperson can handle. But even in these cases, we don’t recommend DIY roof repairs. It may seem like an easy way to save money, but you could easily violate your roof’s warranty and end up spending more in the long run.

### What factors affect how much my roof repair costs?

There are a lot of considerations that go into a roof repair cost estimate. These include the size of your roof, the material, the extent and cause of the damage, labor costs, permit fees, and how easy it is to access your roof. This is why no roofer can give you a reliable roof repair estimate without looking at your roof first!

### Will my homeowners insurance cover any roof repair costs?

Depending on your policy, your homeowners insurance company may cover some or all of your roof repair costs. This typically depends on how your roof was damaged. If a hurricane or tropical storm tore shingles from your roof, your roof repairs may be covered. But most homeowners insurance policies don’t cover wear and tear.

### What kind of aesthetic do exposed fastener metal roofs have?

Some have described the style of 5V roofing as rugged or industrial. However, some homeowners like having a more unique roof and think it provides a fun juxtaposition with the rest of their property.

### Do exposed fastener metal roofs need a lot of maintenance?

Like most roofs, crimped metal roofing does need some maintenance. This maintenance is mostly centered around keeping the fasteners water-tight and protected against the elements. However, shingle roofs often run into issues like missing shingles, so there’s no reason to think of exposed fastener metal roofs as unique for needing maintenance.

### Are metal roofs noisier in the rain?

Metal roofs can be a little noisier in the rain. However, the difference is minimal, and with proper insulation, your roof shouldn’t be much louder than a shingle roof in the rain.

### Do exposed fastener metal roofs rust?

Nearly any metal roof can rust. However, galvanized steel is coated in a rust-resistant alloy to prevent exactly this issue. If you live within a mile of the coast, you may need to use aluminum instead to prevent rust due to the saltwater air.

### Are exposed fastener metal roofs prone to leaks?

Although the fasteners are exposed, modern washers and sealing techniques are designed to prevent leaks. However, over time, the fasteners and washers may wear down and require periodic replacement to maintain water-tightness.

### How long can I finance a roof replacement for?

Loan terms for roof replacement typically range from 1 to 15 years, depending on the type of financing and the lender’s terms. Paying your loan off more slowly will mean spending more in the long term but with a lower monthly payment. Conversely, paying off a loan quickly is cheaper overall but requires a higher monthly payment.

### Are there special options for roof replacement financing for veterans and seniors?

Yes, there are many programs that help with roof replacement costs for veterans and seniors. However, since these are often private programs, they often depend largely on where you live and your unique circumstances. To learn more about these programs in your area, we recommend contacting your local VA office or elder support services.

### Is it better to pay for a roof replacement upfront or finance it?

If you can, it’s cheaper to pay for a roof replacement yourself. That’s because when you pay upfront, you don’t have to worry about additional fees or interest. However, this isn’t an option for all homeowners. And financing a roof replacement can be much cheaper than keeping a damaged roof on your home, especially during hurricane season! If your roof fails, it could put your entire structure in jeopardy.

### Can I get roof replacement financing with bad credit?

Yes, in almost all cases, you will be able to finance a roof replacement even with bad credit. However, you may not qualify for the best rates. One option to get good rates with bad credit is to have a co-signer with a higher credit score.

### Can I finance a roof replacement with a credit card?

Yes, it is possible to put your roof replacement on your credit card. However, this is possibly the most expensive option for roof replacement financing. With APRs much higher than conventional loan rates, putting your roof on a credit card could cost you a lot of money in the long run.

### How do I know if my home already has hurricane straps?

A professional roofing inspection can determine whether your home has hurricane straps installed. PITCH Roofing offers free estimates and inspections to help you assess your home’s readiness for hurricane season.

### Are hurricane straps only needed for new construction?

No, while some Florida counties require hurricane straps for new construction, they can be added to existing homes as a valuable upgrade. Retrofitting an older home with hurricane straps can provide added peace of mind during hurricane season.

### Can hurricane straps lower my homeowners insurance premiums?

Yes, many insurance companies see hurricane straps as a way to reduce the risk of storm damage, which can lower your premiums. It’s best to check with your insurance provider for specific discounts.

### How much does it cost to install hurricane straps?

The cost to install hurricane straps typically ranges between $1,000 to $1,500, depending on the size of your roof and local labor rates. However, programs like My Safe Florida Home can help offset these costs by covering up to two-thirds of the installation price.

### Do I need hurricane straps for my home in Florida?

While not always legally required, especially for older homes, hurricane straps are a wise investment for any Florida homeowner. They significantly increase your roof’s resistance to high winds and can be essential during hurricane season.

### What are hurricane straps, and how do they work?

Hurricane straps are metal strips that secure your roof to the rest of your home’s structure, acting like seatbelts for your roof during strong winds. Made from durable galvanized steel, they help keep your roof in place during severe storms, reducing the risk of it being torn off.

### Are there any good roof grants or public funds in Pinellas County?

When looking for Pinellas County roofers, grants can be a great way to cut costs. The My Safe Florida Home program is a great way to save money on select roofing services, but you should note that this program does not cover roof replacements.

### What should be included in a Pinellas County roofing estimate?

Generally, you shouldn’t trust roofers who only give you a final number for your roofing estimate. They could be hiding how much they’re charging for certain things, or worse, leaving out essential parts of the job from your estimate. Instead, a good estimate should include the costs of materials, labor, and permitting fees, as well as warranty information and a timeline for the job.

### How long does a roof replacement take in Pinellas County?

How long your roofing services take will always depend on the unique factors of your roof. But in general, replacing a roof in Pinellas County shouldn’t take more than one to three days if the weather cooperates.

### What kind of roofing materials do roofers use in Pinellas County?

Which roofing materials your roofers use will vary from company to company. But at Pitch, we pride ourselves on having mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This includes shingles, tiles, and metal roofing, as well as flat roofing options like TPO and EPDM. If you’re ever unsure whether a roofing company uses the material you want, the best thing you can do is ask!

### How do I know if Pinellas County roofers are really licensed and insured?

You can check a roofer’s license status with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR). To verify their insurance, ask the roofer for a copy of their insurance certificates and verify them with the insurance provider. These extra steps can give you peace of mind when you’re making a major decision!

### Should I take out a home equity loan or get roof financing?

Whether you should take a HELOC or get roof financing depends on your unique financial situation. Home equity loans usually have lower interest rates, but they’re not available to everyone, and you risk losing your home if you default. Roof financing, on the other hand, is faster to acquire, so it’s ideal for situations where you need immediate roofing services.

### How much of a down payment do I need to finance a roof?

Down payments vary widely depending on your payment plan. Some financing plans might require 20% of the total costs upfront, while others might offer 100% financing with no upfront costs.

### Can I only get a shingle roof financed?

No, and in fact there are plenty of metal roofing companies that take payments near you. Roof financing is available for all roofing materials, including flat roofs, so don’t let your immediate budget decide the quality or type of your new roof.

### How long can I finance my roof replacement?

Specific financing terms often come down to a case-by-case basis. That said, roof financing tends to last anywhere from 12 months to 10 years, depending on the amount of money loaned and your specific financing choices.

### Do I need good credit to get a new roof financed in Florida?

Good credit is always helpful in getting the lowest possible rate for your roof financing. But almost all roofers work with people who don’t have perfect credit, and this shouldn’t stop you from getting a good rate on your new roof.

### Do flat roofs have good insulation?

Generally, most flat roofs don’t automatically come with great insulation. But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

### How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?

Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

### What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?

There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

### Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?

Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

### How long do flat roofs last in Florida?

How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

### Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?

Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

### Are metal roofs hurricane-proof?

No roof in the world is immune to hurricanes. However, metal roofs do hold up well against the worst that hurricanes have to offer. So while we can’t guarantee that any roof could withstand a direct Category 5 hurricane, we can tell you that when it comes to holding out against hurricanes, very few materials perform as well as metal roofing.

### Will a metal roof increase my energy bills in the summer?

No, metal roofs do not attract any more heat than other roofing materials so they will not increase your energy bill. On the contrary, they’re better at reflecting UV rays than most shingle roofs. In this way, they can actually save you money.

### Do metal roofs attract lightning?

Tampa Bay is famous for its thunderstorms. But the good news is that they won’t pose any additional danger to you once you get a metal roof. Metal roofs attracting lightning is an old myth, and in fact they’re so noncombustible that lightning striking your metal roof wouldn’t even start a fire.

### Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?

Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

### Can I install a shingle roof myself?

DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

### What’s the best color for a shingle roof?

Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

### Why are shingle roofs so popular?

Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

### What maintenance do shingle roofs need?

In Florida, maintenance is an especially important part of keeping your shingle roof healthy. Routine maintenance includes cleaning gutters, cleaning off any algae or mold that starts to develop, and replacing any shingles that are damaged or removed by the elements.

### How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?

How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

### What's the best kind of tile roof?

Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no "best" type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

### Can I walk on my tile roof?

Technically, you can walk on a tile roof. But we would not recommend that you do. While tiles can support a lot of weight, they're brittle and can easily crack or shatter while people walk on them, which is bad for your roof and very dangerous for whoever is walking on it.

### Are tile roofs expensive?

There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

### Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?

Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

### How long do tile roofs last in Florida?

Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

When we send a crew out to your home or business to complete a job for you, you can rest assured that everyone involved is licensed, insured, and an expert in your chosen roofing material.

### What if I don't know what my roof needs?

Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem!
