### How much does a roof replacement cost in Florida?

The truth is that nobody knows how much the "average" roof costs in Florida, because there's no such thing as an average roof. Every roof is unique, and the cost to fix or replace it will be just as individual as your structure is. That said, we can help you get a ballpark figure!         01
    	  PREPPING YOUR PROPERTY 
													Before starting the roof replacement, PITCH Roofing ensures that your property is well-prepared and protected. We safeguard plants, landscaping, and other delicate areas with protective coverings. Gutters and downspouts are shielded to prevent damage during the work. Additionally, any necessary measures are taken to protect windows, doors, and outdoor furniture. By preparing the site thoroughly, we minimize disruption and ensure a safe, clean working environment throughout the roof replacement process.
        	
        02
    	  ROOF REMOVAL 
													During a roof replacement, our crews remove everything from the old underlayment and flashings to your old roofing material, leaving just your roof decking. By working through each individual layer of your roofing system, we give your new roof the best possible start. This thorough preparation is crucial for laying a solid foundation for the new roof installation, guaranteeing durability and top performance.
        	
        03
    	  PLYWOOD INSPECTION 
													
Once the old roofing material is removed, the PITCH Roofing team conducts a meticulous inspection of your roof’s decking, which may consist of plywood or 1×6 hardboards. This step ensures that everything is up to current building codes and in suitable condition for the new installation. We identify and replace any weak or rotted wood, making necessary corrections to provide a strong, stable foundation for your new roof. This careful preparation helps extend the life of your roof and enhances its overall performance.
        	
        04
    	  WATER BARRIER 
													PITCH Roofing utilizes a high-temperature rated, self-adhering water barrier, strategically installed at critical areas of your roof to ensure maximum protection. This superior product is capable of keeping your roof dry independently, but it primarily serves as a second line of defense against extreme weather conditions. Standard application includes placement in valleys and around roof penetrations. For enhanced resilience, there is an option to upgrade by installing the barrier over the entire roof, thereby creating an exceptionally durable roofing system.
        	
        05
    	  SYNTHETIC UNDERLAYMENT 
													Underlayment is a crucial component of any roofing system, serving a dual purpose. It not only keeps the roof dry during construction but also acts as a long-lasting vapor barrier. At PITCH Roofing, we use a high-strength synthetic underlayment that is 40 times stronger than traditional felt paper. This advanced roofing technology lays flatter and maintains its integrity over time, unlike traditional underlayments, which can degrade. This ensures a more durable and reliable roof for your home.
        	
        06
    	  DRIP EDGE 
													The installation of the drip edge is a key step in constructing your new roof. This component not only strengthens but also protects the perimeter of the roof, laying the groundwork for the subsequent shingle installation. Our standard drip edge is made from 26 gauge metal and is available in five factory-painted colors: black, gray, white, brown, and beige. Additionally, we offer the option to custom fabricate the drip edge in any color you desire, ensuring it perfectly matches your home's aesthetic.
        	
        07
    	  MATERIAL INSTALLATION 
													Your chosen roofing material is the main focal point of your roof, playing a crucial role in keeping your home dry and protected. At PITCH, we tailor our roof installation services to the material and ensure that your roof is properly installed for long-term safety and durability across all parts of your new roofing system. This careful approach helps ensure that your roof is as beautiful as it is functional.
        	
        08
    	  VENT AND PLUMBING FLASHINGS 
													Every home features a unique set of penetrations that emerge through the roof, such as vents and plumbing stacks. We understand that properly waterproofing these penetrations from the outset is crucial to preventing leaks and avoiding future repairs. Our team employs precise techniques and high-quality materials to ensure that each penetration is thoroughly sealed, safeguarding your home against water damage and contributing to the overall longevity of your roof.
We also utilize rodent covers, installed over-top the plumbing penetrations. These guards protect against rodent damage and prevent debris and critters from entering the pipe. They are color-matched to the roof, providing a clean and uniform appearance.
        	
        09
    	  ATTIC VENTILATION 
													Ridge ventilation is a critical feature installed along or near the peaks of the roof, designed to allow excess heat and moisture to escape from the attic space. This not only helps regulate the temperature within your home but also prevents moisture accumulation that can lead to structural damage.
We also carefully calculate the specific ventilation needs of your attic space and employ the best methods to ensure optimal airflow. Our tailored solutions are designed to enhance the efficiency and longevity of your roof, safeguarding your home against potential issues related to poor ventilation.
        	
        10
    	  HIP AND RIDGE CAPS 
													Hip and ridge caps are essential components of a shingle roof, crafted from the same material as the field shingles but specifically designed for use along the peaks and hips. We use these specialized caps to effectively seal the joining sections of a roof, enhancing its overall structural integrity. Additionally, hip and ridge caps contribute to a sleek, finished appearance, ensuring that your roof not only performs excellently but also looks great from every angle.
        	
        11
    	  CLEANUP 
													Our crews understand that the job isn't finished until the site is clean. After completing a roof replacement, our team conducts a thorough cleanup process to ensure your property looks its best. We meticulously remove all debris, nails, and materials from the work area, employing magnetic sweepers to catch any metal objects that might have fallen during the installation. This attention to detail means you can enjoy your new roof without the hassle of post-construction cleanup, ensuring your home and yard are safe and spotless.

			BE IN THE KNOW		
		 FAQs About Roof Replacements

			a
		

		

			
				Will a metal roof increase my energy bills in the summer?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	No, metal roofs do not attract any more heat than other roofing materials so they will not increase your energy bill. On the contrary, they’re better at reflecting UV rays than most shingle roofs. In this way, they can actually save you money.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best color for a shingle roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingle roofs come in many colors, so you will definitely find something that suits your preferences. Earth tones are traditional colors for shingles, but light-colored shingles can help keep your roof cool in the hot summer months.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What’s the best kind of tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Clay tiles last the longest, but there is no “best” type of tile roof. To find the type of tile roof that meets your unique needs, you should discuss your options with a trusted local roofer.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What roofing materials can PITCH work with?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you need a roof repair or a full roof replacement, Pitch’s expert crews have mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This ensures that no matter what your vision for the perfect roof is, we can make sure that you get it. Our most popular roofing materials include:

Asphalt and composite shingles
Clay and concrete roofing tiles
Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
Flat roofing options (TPO, EDPM, modified bitumen, etc.)

With all of these options, we know that we can meet your goals for both aesthetics and protection. To further discuss our extensive style and color options, give us a call our fill out our contact form!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What if I don’t know what my roof needs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem! If you’ve noticed that something isn’t quite right with your roof, maybe a leak or signs of pests, but you aren’t sure what the problem is, call the experts at Pitch. We’ve seen it all, so we’ll be able to quickly diagnose what’s wrong with your roof and walk you through your options for a long-term solution.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	The truth is that nobody knows how much the “average” roof costs in Florida, because there’s no such thing as an average roof. Every roof is unique, and the cost to fix or replace it will be just as individual as your structure is. That said, we can help you get a ballpark figure! Check out our guide to roof replacement costs for a rough idea of how much a new roof can cost in Florida.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How much does a flat roof replacement cost in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Flat roof replacement costs vary based on the local market, unique roofing features, and size of the roof, to name a few factors. That said, a new flat roof can cost anywhere from $8,000 to $20,000 or more.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do metal roofs attract lightning?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tampa Bay is famous for its thunderstorms. But the good news is that they won’t pose any additional danger to you once you get a metal roof. Metal roofs attracting lightning is an old myth, and in fact they’re so noncombustible that lightning striking your metal roof wouldn’t even start a fire.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs have good insulation?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Generally, most flat roofs don’t automatically come with great insulation. But when discussing what type of flat roof you want, you can request additional insulation that will be added during the roof replacement process to help keep your structure energy efficient.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a metal roof over my old roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Placing a new roof on top of an old one is called reroofing, and it’s a common practice with metal roofing. If you’d rather install your new metal roof on top of your old shingles, let our representative know during your initial phone call or meeting. They’ll be happy to explain how we can help you with your re-roofing job!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are tile roofs expensive?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There’s no denying that tile roofs require a substantial up-front investment. But if this investment is something you can afford, it really pays off in longevity and protection for decades to come.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Are metal roofs suitable for Florida’s climate?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, metal roofs are highly suitable for Florida’s climate due to their durability and resistance to high winds, rain, and sun exposure. Rust can present a problem, especially in coastal Florida, but modern metal roofing technology greatly reduces the risk of premature rusting.

		Florida’s Most Common Roof Repairs
Florida is tough on roofs — that’s why you need roofers who are even tougher. Our roof repair experts have mastered all of the most common roof repairs in the state, including:

Roof Leaks: Unlike other roofers, we don’t believe in surface-level patch jobs. Instead, we fix roof leaks at the source and repair any water damage to make sure your roof stays healthy for years to come!
Missing Shingles: If high winds blew some shingles off your roof, we’ve got the solution. We’ll install new shingles to repair your roof and make sure that there’s no underlying water damage waiting to give you a headache down the line!
Puncture Damage: Fixing roof punctures is one of the most common flat roof repairs in Florida. Whether it’s caused by poor installation or normal wear and tear, we can fix the punctures and restore any damaged parts of your roofing system.
Damaged Flashing: Cracked or rotting flashing is a big red flag. But our roof repair pros know how to replace and repair damaged flashing to ensure that your roof stays 100% waterproof.
Trapped Water: Water that ponds on your roof is a big red flag. Thankfully, our roofing experts know how to remove trapped water and make sure that your roof is properly sloped to ensure that this issue doesn’t come up again.

Whether you have a shingle roof, tile roof, metal roof, or flat roof, our roof repair pros can help. We know that for a fact, because unlike other roofing companies in the area, we only send the best crews on our roof repair jobs.

			BE IN THE KNOW		
		 FAQs About Roof Repairs 
		

	






	

	
		c 
		Expand All	

	
		C
		Collapse All	


	
	

		

	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Why are shingle roofs so popular?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Shingles are generally popular because of their durability and affordability. Architectural shingles, especially, are popular in Florida as a low-cost option for roof replacements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What roofing materials can PITCH work with?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Whether you need a roof repair or a full roof replacement, Pitch’s expert crews have mastered a wide variety of roofing materials. This ensures that no matter what your vision for the perfect roof is, we can make sure that you get it. Our most popular roofing materials include:

Asphalt and composite shingles
Clay and concrete roofing tiles
Metal roofing (5V and standing seam)
Flat roofing options (TPO, EDPM, modified bitumen, etc.)

With all of these options, we know that we can meet your goals for both aesthetics and protection. To further discuss our extensive style and color options, give us a call our fill out our contact form!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What maintenance do shingle roofs need?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	In Florida, maintenance is an especially important part of keeping your shingle roof healthy. Routine maintenance includes cleaning gutters, cleaning off any algae or mold that starts to develop, and replacing any shingles that are damaged or removed by the elements.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What if I don’t know what my roof needs?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Not sure what kind of roofing services you need? Not a problem! If you’ve noticed that something isn’t quite right with your roof, maybe a leak or signs of pests, but you aren’t sure what the problem is, call the experts at Pitch. We’ve seen it all, so we’ll be able to quickly diagnose what’s wrong with your roof and walk you through your options for a long-term solution.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				What are the signs that my flat roof needs replaced?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	There are many signs it’s time to replace your flat roof. Cracks or blistering are a big one, as are leaks, ponding water, and any visible signs of wear and tear.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do tile roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs are great at withstanding Florida’s harsh weather patterns. Concrete tile roofs last for roughly 50 years, while clay tile roofs can stay healthy for a century or more!

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do shingle roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long your shingle roof lasts in Florida depends on the type of shingle you choose. Architectural shingles last for up to 25 years, luxury shingles up to 40 years, and composite shingles can keep functioning for up to 50 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				How long do flat roofs last in Florida?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	How long a flat roof lasts in Florida depends on the roofing material used. But on average, a low-slope roof in Florida will last roughly 25 years.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do flat roofs require a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Yes, and flat roof maintenance is essential for Floridians. Flat roofs in Florida are more prone to damage from UV rays, heavy rainfall, and high humidity, so it’s important to keep your roof in top shape.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Do clay tile roofs need a lot of maintenance?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Tile roofs actually require very little maintenance. The most common issue they encounter is cracking shingles from storm debris, but this is both a quick and affordable repair.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I walk on my tile roof?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	Technically, you can walk on a tile roof. But we would not recommend that you do. While tiles can support a lot of weight, they’re brittle and can easily crack or shatter while people walk on them, which is bad for your roof and very dangerous for whoever is walking on it.

		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
			
		
	



	
	
	

		
			a
		

		

			
				Can I install a shingle roof myself?			

		

		

	
	

	
	

		
			
		
			
	DIY shingle roof replacement can seem like a good way to save money. But the truth is that roofing systems are just too complex to be handled by anyone other than professionals. And since a poor shingle roof installation could lead to major issues with permitting and your homeowner’s insurance, we strongly encourage leaving roof replacements to trustworthy local roofers.

Excerpt: Are you dealing with a roof leak that just won’t go away? Not sure if your home or business is ready to handle the next big storm that’s coming through? No matter what problem you’re facing, our experienced roof repair pros are ready to help.

### Storm Damage Restoration

Life in Florida has a lot of positives: great weather, beautiful beaches, and year-round fresh seafood. But there are significant downsides too, namely tropical storms and hurricanes. If and when a major storm does damage to your home, then it’s important to seek out storm damage restoration services to get your home back in shape to protect against the next major storm.That’s where we come in. PITCH Roofing was formed by roofing experts with over 60 years of experience, so we know how to restore roofs after they’ve taken a beating from a passing storm. As you consider local storm damage roofing contractors, let us walk you through how we can help restore your property after a storm.How Florida Roofers Fix Your Roof After a StormOur decades of roofing experience mean that we understand recovering after a storm better than anyone. That’s how we know that it’s all but impossible to get your peace of mind back without a strong, stable structure protecting you and your loved ones.To help you get that back, we provide a wide range of storm damage restoration services, including:Replacing Missing or Bent Shingles: High winds and storm debris can do a lot of damage to your shingle roof. If your shingles are missing or damaged, we’ll replace them with top-of-the-line shingles that match your roof’s current pattern and re-establish your structural stability.Replacing Cracked Tiles: Roofing tiles are great at standing up against wind and rain. Sadly, they're less good at withstanding damage from storm debris. But our crews can replace damaged tiles to restore your roof to 100%.Repairing Damaged Flashing: Flashing plays an essential role in moving water off your roof, but it can easily be damaged in major storms. When this happens, we’ll repair and restore your flashing so that your roof is ready for the next storm.Repairing Damaged Gutters: As local experts on gutter restoration and replacement, we’ll work on your gutters to ensure that they’re moving water away from your structure and depositing it somewhere that doesn’t damage your yard or your home’s foundation.Re-roofing Services: Re-roofing and roof replacements are the biggest storm damage restoration services. But if your roof has taken substantial damage, they could be necessary. Whether we need to remove your old roof or cover it with new roofing materials, we’ll work with you to find the best solution for your home.There are many ways that storms could damage your roof, and we have just as many ways to restore it. With reliable contractors and straightforward communication, we know that we can provide you with the best storm damage restoration services in Florida.		
					Call 727-677-4824				
			WHAT TO LOOK FOR		
		 Signs of Roof Damage Following a Storm  
         	
         
				    					Missing shingles
         	
         
				    					Cracked, curled, or torn shingles  
         	
         
				    					An excessive amount of shingle granules in the gutters 
         	
         
				    					Mold or mildew growth on the interior or exterior surfaces of your roof 
         	
         
				    					Visible sagging or unevenness in your roofline 
         	
         
				    					Cracked or damaged fascia boards (horizontal trim beneath the roof edge) or soffits (underside of the eaves)
         	
         
				    					Dented or damaged flashing around chimneys, vents, or skylights
         	
         
				    					Leaks or water stains, discoloration, or dampness

### Soffit/Fascia Repair & Installation

You’ve invested a lot of energy and money in your property, but that could all be for naught if you’ve got damaged soffit or fascia. Your roof’s soffit is the underside of its overhang, and your fascia is the outward-facing board across the edge of your roof, and they both play an essential role in keeping your roofing system dry and protected.That’s a tall order in Florida, and we should know; our founding roofing pros have been working on roofs for over 60 years! That’s why PITCH Roofing is the best local roofing company to come to when you start noticing signs of rot or wear and tear in your soffit and fascia.Now, let’s talk about what the team at PITCH can do for you!Our Soffit and Fascia ServicesAt PITCH, we handle it all. So whether you’re noticing some chipped paint or severe rot, we can get your soffit and fascia in top shape once more. There are two ways that we can do that, depending on your needs: repair and replacementSoffit and Fascia RepairPitch offers comprehensive soffit and fascia repair services to safeguard the safety and aesthetics of your home. Our team of skilled roofers specializes in identifying and addressing issues such as rot, water damage, and deterioration, restoring the efficiency and appearance of your soffit and fascia.With a professional’s attention to detail and quality craftsmanship, we can repair minor soffit and fascia damage like cracks and splits or loose, damaged panels. Trust us to protect your home with expert soffit and fascia repairs provided by local roofers who know how to Florida-proof your home.Soffit and Fascia InstallationWhether your soffit and fascia have sustained severe damage from a nasty storm, pests, or normal aging, our skilled team is ready to remove your old soffit and fascia and install new, healthy replacements. This way, your home can get a boost to its looks and its security!From meticulously removing the old materials to installing high-quality replacement boards, we ensure that your soffit and fascia are ready for the next storm that blows by. Trust us to enhance the beauty and fine-tune the protection of your property with our expert soffit and fascia installation services.		
					Call 727-677-4824				
																												Get Your Soffit and Fascia Restored or ReplacedWhatever issue you’re seeing in your soffit and fascia, you can bet that our experienced crew has seen it before and knows how to help. And more than that, you can count on us working with you every step of the way to keep you informed on the state of your roofing system and empower you to make thoughtful, informed choices for your property.As the cherry on top, starting the roofing process has never been easier! You can call us at 727-677-4824 or fill out our contact form to schedule your free estimate.Choose PITCH to be your trusted local roofing company. We were founded by veteran roofers who wanted to fix the rampant problems in the Florida roofing scene, so give us a chance to show you how much better roofing can be when you have local pros on your side!

### Gutter Installation & Repair

You probably don’t spend a lot of time thinking about your gutters, but they play an essential role in protecting your property in Florida. By directing water away from your structure, they can protect your foundation and your landscaping. Damaged gutters, on the other hand, quickly become a breeding ground for pests and other nuisances.We’re here to make sure you don’t have to deal with the problems that come with old, damaged gutters. PITCH is a full-service roofing company based right here in Pinellas County and serving almost the entire state of Florida. Now, let’s talk about what our crews of experienced roofing professionals can do to make sure your gutters are still effectively protecting your home.Florida Gutter Replacement & Repair ServicesIf you’re noticing leaks or other signs of wear and tear in your gutters, then it’s time to have a professional take a look. And when you choose PITCH, we’ll walk you through your options and make sure you’re making an informed decision on your property.One of the most common options for light wear and tear is repairing your gutters, which could include patching, realigning, and/or replacing sections of your gutters. By fixing the damaged parts of your gutters, we can make sure that your entire roofing system is operating at peak efficiency.Sometimes, for more substantial damage, we may need to entirely replace your gutters. When this happens, we’ll go step-by-step to explain your options, from material choices like aluminum or vinyl to choosing your new type and style of gutters like K-style or box gutters.Gutter Guard InstallationCleaning gutters is a pain, but clogged gutters can’t serve their essential purpose. To keep your gutters functional while minimizing the amount of maintenance they need, we can install gutter guards on your home. These additions to your gutters can help keep leaves, tree nuts, and other debris out of your gutters, which greatly cuts down on the need for regular gutter cleanings.

Excerpt: There are many reasons why you might need a roof inspection, from selling your property to getting insurance approval for your roof to regular maintenance. But regardless of why you need a roof inspection, it’s crucial that you pick the best roofers for the job.

### Leak Detection

A leaking roof isn’t just a minor annoyance: It’s a serious threat to your home or business. And the first step in fixing the problem is enlisting professional leak detection services.That’s what PITCH is here for. With our crew of experienced roofing professionals, we can quickly and efficiently identify the source of your leak. From there, we’ll work with you to decide whether you need roof repairs or a full roof replacement.But before we get into how our leak detection services can help you, let’s talk about what you should know about roof leaks in Florida.Causes of Roof Leaks in FloridaIn hurricane-prone Florida, you can do everything right and still end up with roof leaks. When roof leaks appear, though, it isn’t always clear why or where the leak started. This is partially because of the many different ways that a leak can develop in the roof of your home or business.The most common ways that a leak will develop in your roof include:Shingle removal due to wind uplift, exposing your roof to water damageRot caused by pests and/or mold buildupNormal wear and tear over the yearsFaulty roof installation that left structural instabilityNo matter what the cause of your leak is, leak detection services can help get to the root of the problem. And when you choose PITCH as your trusted local roofers, there’s no limit to what we can do to help you.

		What Comes After Leak Detection?Once we’ve found the source of your leak, we’ll speak with you to discuss the next steps.In the best-case scenario, we will have found very little damage beyond the source of your leak. This means that we’ll most likely be able to repair your roof quickly and easily without doing too much damage to your wallet.Sometimes, however, the leak can do considerable water damage throughout your roofing system. This is especially likely if the leak has been ongoing for months. In cases like these, where damage is widespread, we may have to replace sections or all of your roof. If this happens, we’ll work with you to develop a roof replacement plan that suits your needs.In short, PITCH has your back regardless of the results of our leak detection services.
